articleTitle: Indoor Air Quality Monitoring System with Automation: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Indoor air quality is affected by household pollution. Household pollution is dangerous where humans carry out most of their activities at home (indoors). Some researchers previously suggested indoor air quality (IAQ) monitoring systems mostly to measure air quality in real-time. This study provides a reflection of the literature regarding indoor air quality monitoring system with automation. The aim of this study is to present a literature review to support future research initiatives on the implementation of indoor air quality monitoring systems. The result of this study is that 55 percent of the reviewed studies haven’t applied an automatic system to their indoor air quality monitoring, the top two microcontrollers are on a single development board, and the top three parameters used in the previous IAQ monitoring studies aren’t in line with WHO guidelines. In addition, only 25 percent of studies use the forecasting method.

articleTitle: Digital Signature Chain for Security and Integrity Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Digital signatures have been widely used by both private and government agencies. However, the use of chain digital signatures is still not widely used, especially in the military world, this results in a lack of ability to ensure data integrity, where it will be difficult to find out who has made changes to the document and to find out the original source of the document. This paper proposes a digital signature chain as a solution to guarantee data authenticity and prevent tampering during transmission. This technique involves creating a chain of digital signatures that are attached to data before it is sent over the network. The proposed method is expected to provide a more secure and efficient way to ensure data integrity, compared to traditional methods such as encryption and checksums. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed method through a series of experiments and shows that digital signature chains are an effective and reliable way to secure and maintain data transmission over networks. The proposed research aims to evaluate the effectiveness of digital signature chain technology in ensuring data security and integrity and to provide recommendations for its implementation.

articleTitle: User Experience Evaluation on kompas.com Online News Portal Using User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to evaluate the level of satisfaction of the mobile version of news portal website, Kompas.com. This study uses User Experience Questionnaire to measure attractiveness, classical usability aspects (efficiency, perspicuity, and dependability) and user experience aspects (novelty, stimulation). The respondents for this research were users of Kompas.com website, particularly the mobile version. Total of respondents used as research samples was 101 people. Results from the User Experience Questionnaire shows that the mobile website of Kompas.com falls into the Good category for Perspicuity at 1.059, Efficiency at 0.772, Dependability at 1.106, Stimulation at 0.874, Novelty aspects at 0.748, and Neutral category for Attractiveness aspect at 0.691. Meanwhile, the benchmarking result for the website of Kompas.com mobile version with the data that UEQ provided shows that Attractiveness at 0.69, Perspicuity at 1.06, Efficiency at 0.77, Dependability at 1.11, Stimulation at 0.87 aspects falls into the Below Average category, while the Novelty aspect at 0.75 falls into the Above Average category. This study proposes a new design to cover the weaknesses and usability testing has been carried out to test the new design with acceptable results and improves user experience.

articleTitle: Sociomaterial Imbrication; The Role of Chatbot on Customer Experience
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The rapid development of technology also occurred in the Hotel Industry. The combination of technology services and human services in hotels to both serve hotel customers created overlaps services. This research focuses on chatbots as a technology, in their role to shape customer experience in hotels, in a way that does not cover the role of humans as employees who are the main assets of the hotel. The study employed purposive sampling as the sample technique, and it was done at a four-star hotel. The analysis method used is SEMPLS. The results showed that the use of chatbots with UTAUT shows that the performance expectancy of the chatbot represents the desired behavioral interests of customers so that the customer experience gets a positive and significant value.

articleTitle: User Experience in Retail Furniture (IKEA Store) as a Model for Space Circulation in Apartment Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study explores how the user experience at IKEA stores based on space circulation and its use in an apartment relate to one another. Despite being regarded as a comfortable place to live, apartments have limited space to accommodate the needs of facilities and activities used by residents, particularly in circulation. Additionally, it includes restrictions on how furniture should be arranged, which affects how apartments are often laid out. How can users arrange living space in apartments using the IKEA store’s user experience in space circulation as a model? His study used descriptive analysis using IKEA showrooms and studio apartments as a case study. It is intended that the outcomes of this study will be used as references for residential standard dimensions involved in the arrangement of facilities and circulation in confined spaces.

articleTitle: Object Oriented Fuzzy Decision Model for Insurance Claim
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The insurance industry faces a significant challenge concerning insurance claims, particularly due to the prevalence of fraudulent insurance claims. To address this issue, one potential solution is the implementation of a computer-based decision model. This research presents a fuzzy decision model based on object-oriented method development. The study involves seven stages (i.e. case analyzing, parameter analyzing, objects-parameters linking, detail object relation constructing, parameter exchange analyzing, OOFDM constructing, and model verifying and validating), with an object-oriented approach serving as the foundational method for constructing the model, and fuzzy logic as the primary method for assessing claim risks in proposing the best decision. The model has the capability to simulate insurance claims and offers objective decisions based on 19,611 claims data, categorizing them into two decision categories: acceptance and pending.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Smart Technology for Virtual Museum Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In recent years, the development of intelligent technology has had a significant impact on the development of virtual museums. Therefore, knowledge mapping is needed to describe and analyze trends, implementation, and benefits of using smart technology in virtual museums. This study used bibliometric methods. The results is smart technology for virtual museum research tends to a downward trend in research productivity. The productive year for this study was 2019. While the type of documents related to this research on Scopus indexation is dominated by conference papers with 51 documents or 63.7%. The dominant publication source for this research is Lecture Notes in Computer Science including Subseries Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence and Lecture Notes in Bioinformatics with 11 documents. The affiliation with the most documents is MARA University of Technology with 2 documents, and the most productive country in this study is China with 15 documents. From the results of research mapping, it was found that research in the field of smart technology for virtual museums still has great opportunities to be applied to applicable themes such as the application of local wisdom content that can enrich research topics.

articleTitle: Analyzing User Experience in SEVA Application: A User Experience Questionnaire Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyze the user experience satisfaction of customers using SEVA application. In this research using a User Experience Questionnaire, a survey was carried out by distributing an online questionnaire via Google form to respondents. Based on the evaluation from 101 respondents results, it was found that the evaluation value of the attractiveness aspect is 1,678 (good), the Aspect of Clarity is 1,814 of evaluation value (good), the Aspect of Efficiency has an evaluation value of 1,651 (good), the Aspect of accuracy gets 1,483 for evaluation value (good), Stimulation gets an evaluation value of 1,267 (above average) and Novelty gets an evaluation value of 1,012 (above average) so that improvement is needed in stimulation and novelty. Improvements to the stimulation and novelty aspect can be made by updating the application regularly so that the application does not seem monotonous, updates can be in the form of updating the appearance or features in the application, then based on the results, customers expect that SEVA can add a car scan feature.

articleTitle: Optimizing Age Classification Using Hyperparameter Tuning and Handling Imbalanced Dataset: An Algorithm Decision Forest training Algorithms Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Age classification is a specialist field, and imbalanced datasets and hyperparameter tuning are essential issues that can increase the superiority of classification models. This study proposes a new method for age classification optimization using the Decision Forest training technique, focusing on hyperparameter tuning and handling imbalanced datasets. With substantial improvements in handling minority classes, this research aims to improve the model’s classification accuracy. A robust model that shows resistance to overfitting was created by utilizing the capabilities of the Decision Forest algorithm model. The accuracy and loss are excellent; the highest is K-FOLD 5: Accuracy: 0.9512 and Loss: 0.2172. This innovative study presents significant breakthroughs regarding age categorization and a workable approach for researchers to perform appropriate hyperparameter adjustments when dealing with imbalanced data. This represents a tremendous advance in the classification field and an exciting path of research and application

articleTitle: Analyzing Company’s Share Purchase Value Based on Financial Reports Using Artificial Neural Network (ANN)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Because financial time series forecasting is sensitive to political, economic, and social factors, it is not a simple task. As a result, those who make investments in currency exchange and financial markets typically search for reliable models that can guarantee they will maximize their profile and minimize their losses. Fortunately, many studies have used a method from Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) called Backpropagation, could improve the predictive accuracy of the behavior of the financial data over time. This paper aims to forecast stock share prediction from closing value of PT. Bank Central Asia Tbk, and PT. Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk. The results show that the using Backpropagation gives the closest result. And for the rating of judgement for cast accuracy, it exceeded 10% accuracy, which means high accurate from the prediction. For further checking, comparing the results of research from Victor’s results, it almost hits the same accuracy percentage. Which means, these prediction are accurate enough to do time series forecasting.

articleTitle: Strategic Planning For Information Systems Optimization Of Vocational Higher Education Facilities And Infrastructures At The Ministry Of Education, Culture, Research And Technology (E-Sarpras)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The development of technology in the current era is very fast, because of that every’ institution is competing to utilize the technology including Kemendikbudristek with “E-SARPRAS” application that is used as a central data for vocational education facilities and infrastructure. This study aims to make a plan for optimization of the information system in “Sarana dan Prasarana Pendidikan Tinggi Vokasi (E-SARPRAS) ”. E-SARPRAS is a web-based application that use to facilitate all institutional services and Vocational Higher Education Resources all over Indonesia. This application used by kemendikbudristek is outdated and need adjustment to follow current condition of vocational education. The research method for the analysis of optimization needs is an interview and literature review. John Ward and Joe Peppard’s method was used to produce IS strategic planning with PEST analysis, CSF analysis, value chain analysis, Porter’s Five Competitive Models and SWOT analysis and McFarlan’s Strategic Map. Information System strategic planning produced from this study is beneficial for the company.

articleTitle: Development Health Machine of Heavy Equipment Condition Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Monitoring the performance of machines is crucial because any damages that occur within the machines can result in losses and additional costs for the company. Currently, there are performance monitoring systems available for specific types of machines, such as excavators and dump trucks, provided by Komatsu under the names VHMS and Komtrax. However, these systems are not available for the GD825A-2 motor grader model. This research aims to implement an loT system to monitor the real-time condition of heavy equipment, facilitating and improving the analysis of the equipment’s data. The research utilizes an experimental method by testing the loT system on heavy equipment in a real industrial environment. The system consists of sensors installed on the machines and a gateway connected to the internet. The sensor data is transmitted to the gateway and stored on a server, then analyzed and processed using machine learning algorithms to detect potential machine damage. The analysis results are displayed on a user dashboard that can be accessed online. The test results demonstrate that the loT system can accurately monitor machine conditions, help enhance operational efficiency, and reduce maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Flood Forecasting Using Weather Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Many of us have experienced flooding in Malaysia. It has several negative effects on our way of life, including shortage of food, mortality, and property destruction. To reduce the impact of flood disasters on our daily lives, flood forecasting is important. The weather warning is vital to safeguarding people and property. Despite the ability to analyze climate change due to the rapid development of geographic information systems and the availability of data from several sources, data mining applications are scattered and systematic efforts on climate data mining are limited. Thus, our proposed system aims to provide insight into weather changes. The system will be able to predict floods by using weather parameters such as rainfall and temperature. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) can be applied to these parameters in order to predict future weather. RNN is an efficient method because it can handle sequential data and accept both the input data being used now and inputs from the past as the internal memory allows them to remember prior inputs. This system can have easier access to the rainfall conditions ahead. Besides, Predictions of extreme weather changes or natural disasters might be used to implement preventive measures.

articleTitle: Big Asian Countries Economic Recovery Post Covid-19 Pandemic Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The effects of the Covid-19 pandemic which has caused a decline in the world economy are still being felt today, all countries affected by Covid-19 are trying to improve their economic conditions, including in 5 Asian countries such as Indonesia, the Philippines, Türkiye, India and Vietnam. The economic downturn has had a big impact on the community, so that in this stage of improvement, many people are participating in comments and giving their opinions on social media. Therefore, data research was carried out using the Naive Bayes Algorithm where the data will be processed using text mining, then proceed with classifying tweets into two classes, namely positive and negative. The results of the process that has been carried out show that Indonesia received the highest positive comments of 289 positive comments and received an accuracy value of 80.2%.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis of E-Procurement Applications in Energy Sector Companies Using User Experience Questionnaire and Usability Testing Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: To support Good Corporate Governance, energy sector companies must use a centralized portal to procure goods and services. However, the E-Procurement application at energy sector companies has never been analyzed. UX will cause the quality and performance of the application to be unknown, as well as the level of satisfaction for users. The objective of the research is to analyze E-Procurement applications in energy sector companies using user experience questionnaires and usability testing methods. This study uses the UEQ and Usability Testing methods to evaluate procurement applications implemented by energy sector companies. The results showed an efficiency of 77%, an error rate of 67% and a satisfaction level of 73%. Improvements are needed, especially in the display of goods and services providers on the application’s start page, navigation of the document upload process, and more explicit system error notifications. This research provides important insights for energy sector companies about the importance of UX principles in procurement applications and scientific contributions in evaluating the usefulness of applications in the energy sector. The academic contribution to expanding the body of knowledge and literature of usability testing methodologies that employ the UEQ and Usability Testing approaches, and the practical contribution is the reference for future e-procurement applications.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Early Predicting Dropout Student Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Online learning is different from offline learning in the classroom with supervision from the lecturer. Online learning using the Learning Management System (LMS) media requires high awareness from students because their learning activities are not supervised, they are free to study wherever and whenever, so they need to manage and control their own study time without the help of lecturers or administrators. This is one of the causes of the high dropout rate among online learning students, so it is very important for lecturers and administrators to support students in a timely manner to avoid the risk of dropping out. This study uses access log data recorded in the LMS and student statistical information and calculated data and aims to present a suitable predictive algorithm for dropout early prediction systems for online learning students using machine learning. Of the 4 algorithms used, the highest recall value is in Naive Bayes (1), the highest precision is in Logistic Regression with Lasso (1), while the highest accuracy value (0.99) and F1score (0.97) are obtained from the Support Vector Machine which has value equal to Logistic Regression with Lasso. In general, the early dropout prediction model will allow lecturers and administrators to focus on students who have the potential to dropout and take quick action to improve their learning performance so as to reduce the number of student dropouts.

articleTitle: Binary to Decimal Conversion and Subnetting Calculations using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper studies markerless augmented reality applications for displaying digital objects on different colored surfaces under varying lighting conditions and tracking angles. The study aimed to evaluate the application’s effectiveness in accurately displaying digital objects. The testing was conducted in bright and dark light settings, with tracking angles of 45° and 90°. The results showed that surfaces with a texture in dark or bright colors, especially patterned surfaces, yielded optimal results in displaying digital objects in both lighting conditions. However, plain bright surfaces and surfaces without patterns were not practical for displaying digital objects. The angle of the tracking device and the presence of shadows significantly impacted the quality of the displayed objects. The tracking distance did not significantly affect the display quality. These findings provide valuable insights for enhancing the performance and usability of markerless augmented reality applications, guiding the selection of suitable surfaces and lighting conditions for optimal display outcomes.

articleTitle: Development of an Image-Based Road Pothole Detection Model with U-Net implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Road infrastructure maintenance has become crucial in the era of rapid technological advancements to ensure road user safety and mobility. This research aimed to address the pressing issue of potholes through an innovative approach by introducing an image-based method for pothole detection that offers enhanced accuracy and efficiency. Our approach recognizes and categorizes potholes based on their severity levels by leveraging image segmentation through the U-Net convolutional neural network architecture. However, the real innovation lies in our comprehensive strategy considering their severity levels. This approach provides a broader perspective and facilitates informed decision-making in road maintenance management. Our methodology is based on a diverse dataset encompassing various types and conditions of roads, forming a solid foundation for in-depth analysis of pothole size distribution. Our findings support the remarkable effectiveness of the U-Net approach in pothole detection and differentiating image segmentation levels based on severity. Comparative analysis with contemporary methods further reinforces the potential of our proposed approach in enhancing pothole detection accuracy. By contributing an effective and practical approach, this research significantly enriches the detection methodologies domain for real-world road maintenance management applications. Our proposed method intends to provide a holistic solution to the pothole problem, thereby improving road safety and travel efficiency of road users.

articleTitle: Psychological Risk, Security Risk and Perceived Risk of the Cryptocurrency Usage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Today’s technology is increasingly advanced and developing, changing payment and investment methods. The emergence of crypto currencies represents the most recent innovation. Cryptocurrencies have attracted the attention of information technology professionals, economists, investors, banks and governments. However, aside from the advantages, there is also the expectation of cryptocurrencies of potential risks in using currency. This study aims to identify the factors influencing the decision to use cryptocurrency. The factors discussed are perceived risk, psychological risk and security risk. This study used a purposive sampling technique. The data were analysed using PLS-SEM with a final sample of 181 respondents. The results show that psychological, security and perceived risks significantly affect cryptocurrency usage. A relatively new technology makes it easier for individuals to make decisions about using cryptocurrencies. However, lack of information often causes individuals to face uncertainty and various levels of risk. However, individual decisions in using technology are not only influenced by risks but also benefit factors.

articleTitle: Digimaps in Dashboard for Periodic Inspection Checklist for Transmission Network, Distribution Substation, and PLTU Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research addresses the challenge of manual spreadsheet-based maintenance data collection at PT. Energia Prima Nusantara (EPN), a key player in the energy sector. EPN relies on monthly inspections to monitor equipment conditions in power plants and distribution networks. The study employs Unified Modeling Language (UML) and prototype development as key methodologies to design an information system dashboard and validate the application’s design and features, laying the foundation for future development. The results demonstrate that the integration of UML and prototyping in designing the information system dashboard and the DIGIMAPS mobile application significantly enhances the efficiency and effectiveness of power plant system management while reducing data collection errors. The integrated information system dashboard and DIGIMAPS serve as a digital checklist, streamlining field reporting for mechanics and enabling real-time equipment monitoring for PT. EPN. This system also expedites informed decision-making by the general manager. Overall, this research offers an integrated and effective solution to the maintenance data collection challenge at PT. EPN and provides a blueprint for the development of the dashboard and application. The implication is that leveraging both UML and prototyping in developing an information system dashboard and a mobile application can guide other companies in building efficient and effective information systems.

articleTitle: Service Oriented Fuzzy Decision Model for Road Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: A number of attempts have already been implemented formally to solve road traffic congestion. However, the objective strategy type of road traffic engineering could not be proven truly. Try and error is one inefficient way in road traffic engineering to degrade the level of congestion. The study was conducted to propose a new service-oriented model (SOM) that combines fuzzy-logic and water flow algorithm methods (called FWFA). The method combination was operated as the main method to construct the decision model for selecting the objective strategy in road traffic engineering. Also, service-oriented architecture (SOA) is realized to implement such a constructed model practically. The Model can suggest the most optimal strategy decision in road traffic engineering. Here, a main traffic road of Juanda in area Ciputat, Tangerang Selatan, province Banten, Indonesia; was selected as a research object in this study. The constructed SOM for road traffic engineering was structurally delivered in this paper.

articleTitle: IoT and Blockchain Technology Integration Models for Transparency and Protection of Sales and Purchase Luxury Products
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Luxury goods are products that have a relatively high value, so their ownership is only limited to certain people who have the financial ability to buy them. Luxury goods require a security system to protect them from theft and other misuse. In the context of buying and selling luxury goods, a sales mechanism with high transparency is needed. The current problem is that the sale of luxury goods does not yet have a mechanism that provides valid and real-time information about the authenticity and history of the luxury goods being bought and sold. This research aims to help luxury goods owners protect their goods using blockchain technology and the Internet of Things. The result of this research is an IoT and blockchain integration model to increase the protection and transparency of luxury goods buying and selling transactions. At the end of the paper, the author adds an example of data simulation with hash values or block assets for each block, which confirms the linkage between blocks on the blockchain network.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Regarding the Name of “Nusantara” in Indonesia’s New Capital City Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The decision of the government of the Republic of Indonesia to move the national capital from the Special Region of Jakarta to East Kalimantan became a hot topic of conversation among the people. Various capital city names have sprung up, including “Nusantara.” By applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology, this study aims to analyze public sentiment toward naming the new capital city of the Republic of Indonesia as “Nusantara.” This research uses the Cross Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRIS-PDM) method for its development and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm for sentiment classification. The data used in this study amounted to 4,344 Indonesian language text data, which would then be used for the preprocessing stage, followed by the vectorization stage using FastText and classified using CNN. The results show that the CNN algorithm has a sentiment classification accuracy value of 90%. Based on the results of an in-depth analysis, the number of positive sentiments was greater, with a total of 1,566, compared to a negative sentiment which amounted to 1,459 and a neutral sentiment which amounted to 1,319. The results of this sentiment analysis show that most Indonesian people can accept the name “Nusantara” as the new capital of the Republic of Indonesia.

articleTitle: Classroom Activities Detection Using You Only Look Once V3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Theft is a crime that often occurs in various places, including in the classroom. Currently, managers of educational institutions often use CCTV camera security systems to monitor and also use CCTV recordings as evidence as stipulated in applicable laws. Some applications are able to detect when an object is being monitored by the camera and then send a notification that a foreign object is being monitored by the camera. However, it cannot distinguish whether the object is committing a crime or not. Moving objects can be detected by several algorithms. One of them is You Only Look Once (YOLO) V3. YOLO works only by taking images with the highest probability value so that the detection process becomes faster. YOLO makes predictive evaluation of a single network unlike R-CNN which requires thousands of networks on a single image. YOLO V3 comes as a result of improvisation and development from the previous version which has better detection capabilities. YOLO V3 works by predicting squares at 3 different scales. Then Darknet-53 extracts features from that scale using a concept similar to network feature pyramids. This study uses YOLO V3 to detect moving objects and identify whether there has been a crime on the object or not. Based on 5 test schemes with variants of the number of datasets that have been carried out, the best model is the model that is trained using the variant data train and data test 90:10 with an accuracy value of 99.1%. This algorithm can detect both classes of objects well.

articleTitle: Perceived Trust of Paylater and Relaxation Shopping: Gender as A Moderator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to examine the impact of perceived trust and ease of use online features of Paylater on relaxation shopping behaviours. Besides, this study has examined gender as a moderator between perceived trust and ease of use of online features of Paylater on relaxation shopping behaviours. The respondents were sampled from millennials who had already utilised and experienced Paylater. The sampling technique has utilised the purposive sampling technique. Statistical results of 251 millennials who participated show that perceived trust has a significant relationship with relaxation in shopping behaviour. No evidence exists that ease of use has a positive and significant relationship with relaxation in shopping behaviour. We found that gender does not play an important role in moderating the relationship between perceived trust and ease of use online features of Paylater on relaxation shopping behaviours. We conclude that choosing the right online feature on the online commerce platform drives consumer shopping. We suggested the online systems developer design the ease of use functionality and ensure that online shopping apps provide convenience to consumers.

articleTitle: The Transfer Learning Influence on YOLO v8 Performance For Motorbike Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The number of motorbike theft case in Indonesia has increasing rapidly. This phenomenon led to the increasing of the criminal number especially motorbike theft case. Nowadays, the use of CCTV (Closed Circuit Television) camera has been widely applied. Nevertheless, CCTV does not has the ability to prevent criminal acts such motorbike theft case. Therefore, there is a need of a technology based to prevent motorbike theft acts. This research proposed an initial research of motorbike theft detection system that focused on the process of motorbike detection using Deep Learning approach. In this research, the YOLO architecture was utilized to detect the motorbike object inside an image frame. There are two testing scenarios for motorbike detection process, using trained model, and using pre-trained model. The trained model obtain better result rather than using pre-trained model by achieving 0.93 of its accuracy that proven the YOLO v8 model are working well especially when it is applied with transfer learning process for its based model.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis using System Usability Scale Method on Diskominfo Website
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The main responsibility of the Communication and Informatics Service (Diskominfo) in Mojokerto Regency is to share information from the local government with the wider community. One way that the government communicates with the community is through the Diskominfo website, which was launched in 2017. However, the website has not been evaluated or updated and some of its displays are no longer compatible with the latest browsers. Therefore, it is crucial to evaluate and improve the website to provide a better user experience. To measure user satisfaction with the Diskominfo website, a study was conducted using the System Usability Testing method, which involves 10 questions and 5 Likert scales. The study collected data from 84 respondents using Google Forms. The results of the study indicated a SUS score of 61, which falls under category D, indicating that the system is acceptable but with a very low acceptance rate. The study suggests that improvements and updates are necessary, including changes to the feature layout, main page layout, and structuring the order of information in accordance with the most recent developments.

articleTitle: Prayer Hall Vacancy Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)

authors.preferredName: Muhammad Naqib Syahmi Bin Ab Razak

abstract: The issue of overcrowding in prayer rooms located in public areas, such as shopping centers, educational institutions, and other public spaces during prayer times, is a matter of concern nowadays. This condition has the potential to induce discomfort and adversely impact public health issues due to the increased risk of disease transmission, particularly respiratory illnesses. To address this issue, this paper presents a proof-of-concept system that uses computer vision techniques to detect, track, and count the number of people entering and exiting a prayer hall and subsequently count the total number of vacancies. The proposed system is based on the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm the Centroid Tracker object tracking algorithm and an existing object counting method. A custom dataset of 1,993 images of people entering and exiting a prayer hall was collected, cleaned, and annotated for use in training the system. The results of a sample video inference showed an average people detection mAP score of 98.9% and a people counting accuracy of 40% running on a Macbook Pro with an Ml chip. The counting results were displayed on a web app platform hosted on the Heroku cloud application platform.

articleTitle: Building a Better Future-A Website for YSBM Foundation to Promote Quality Education and Nutritious Meals for Underprivileged Children
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: YSBM Foundation (Yayasan Saluran Berkat Mandiri) is a foundation dedicated to assisting underprivileged children and families at the bottom of the socioeconomic pyramid by providing them access to healthy food, quality education, and opportunities to break the cycle of poverty to have a sustainable future. To extend its impact and connect with a broader audience, YSBM recognizes the need for a website communicating its mission, goals, and programs. This website will serve as a platform to showcase the foundation’s accomplishments, engage potential donors, and raise awareness about their cause. This research will implement design principles in the wireframe and the high-fidelity prototype, which is essential in coherently organizing content and sections on the website when using a consumer-centric strategy. The design principle also helps ensure seamless navigation and easy access to desired information, fostering meaningful user engagement with the website. The quantitative test results show that the YSBM website scores better than the general benchmark pragmatically and hedonically. Meanwhile, the qualitative test results also received positive input from users.

articleTitle: Evaluation of User Experience on Taspen otentikasi Application Using User Experience Questionnaire (Case Study of PT. TASPEN (Persero))
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: PT TASPEN (Persero) is one of the state-owned companies engaged in insurance, especially insurance for civil servants and state officials. In carrying out its business processes, PT TASPEN (Persero) collects updated data on pension recipients through the Taspen Otentikasi application. The purpose of this research is to evaluate the Taspen Otentikasi application, especially in terms of user experience. The evaluation was conducted online by distributing questionnaires and then the data was processed using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ). Analysis was carried out from the results of the questionnaire which was then assessed using UEQ tools which were grouped into 6 assessment categories, namely attractiveness, clarity, stimulation, novelty, efficiency, and accuracy. The results showed a good evaluation value in the aspects of Attractiveness (mean 1.74), Clarity (mean 1.91), Stimulation (mean 1.67), Novelty (mean 1.26) while for the Efficiency aspect (mean 1.93) and the Accuracy aspect (mean 1.80) received an Excellent score. UEQ tools can find parts or features that require improvement and development so as to further maximize the use and functionality of the Taspen Otentikasi application in digitizing services.

articleTitle: Assistance of cybercrime:Practice in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Cybersecurity is emerging as one of the efforts to deal with cybercrime. The increase in the number of cybercrimes requires attention. Like conventional crime, cyber crime is also acknowledging the role of assistance. Cybercrime assistance in the Electronic Information and Transaction Law often refers to providing hardware, software, passwords, and access codes as stated in Article 34. Using normative juridical research and analysis of 47 court decisions in 2012-2022, this research found that cybercrime assistance does not only provide device facilities, computer passwords, and access codes. Assistance is also provided in other forms that may not correlate with technology such as providing information, opening a bank account and physical assistance. On condition that the perpetrator’s actions meet the requirements of aiding a crime in Article 56 of the Criminal Code, the perpetrator is classified as assisting. Thus, the scope of assistance has a broad scope as long to assist the activity classified as cybercrime as stated in the Electronic Information and Transaction Law. The result of this study can provide additional insight to understand cybercrime as crime that is often associated with the use of ICT. It helps for public legal awarness’s program that is required to minimize cybercrime.

articleTitle: Features Reduction with PCA Technique for Malware Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Malware had been a problem for quite some times since it spreads easily and can cause various problems. Currently, malware is also one of the big threats for internet users. With a huge number of internet users today, techniques that can automatically detect malware before it infects the system is required. This study aims to develop malware detection using machine learning approach with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) as feature reduction. PCA (Principal Component Analysis) is expected to be able to reduce the number of features which then could also reduce the learning time but do not reduce its accuracy significantly. There were four machine learning classifiers used in this study, i.e. K-Nearest Neighbor, Decision Tree, Naïve bayes, and Random Forest. The n-components used in this study were 20 and 34 and the ratio of test and train in the dataset was 35% for test and 65% for training. The results have shown that the best performance come from the detection using random forest with 34 n-component and 100 n-estimator with the average accuracy was 0.991688.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Distributed Database System in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research discusses the performance evaluation of distributed database systems in a cloud computing environment Cloud computing environments allow data and applications to be stored and deployed on infrastructure located in different parts of the world. However, the use of distributed database systems in cloud computing environments can cause performance issues, such as complex data access and factors such as network latency, security, and scalability that affect system performance. Therefore, performance evaluation of distributed database systems is necessary to ensure effective data management across the infrastructure. The purpose of this research is to measure and understand the performance of distributed database systems in a cloud computing environment. This is important because proper performance evaluation is needed to ensure distributed database systems can operate effectively and efficiently in such environments. This research will analyze the features of distributed database systems, factors that affect performance, how to measure and compare system performance, and how to improve system performance. Analyzing the performance of distributed database systems in a cloud computing environment can help users choose the most appropriate and efficient cloud computing platform for their business needs and improve operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Behavior Design in Hexapod Robots using Finite State Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Hexapod robots are known for their stability and adaptability, which makes them particularly suitable for a wide range of applications. For a robot to successfully navigate its environment, it must have the ability to detect and avoid obstacles. This is where FSM comes into play to model robot behavior and decision-making processes. The output actions of FSM include forward action, reverse action, right turn action, and left turn action. This action allows the hexapod robot to avoid obstacles in its path by adjusting its movements. FSM is designed to transition between states based on sensory input, such as information from the robot’s sensors, to determine the best action to be taken in response to the presence of an obstruction. The design of the FSM is described in detail, and its performance is evaluated in simulations. Results show that the effectively designed FSM allows the hexapod robot to avoid obstacles in its environment, while ensuring efficient and safe navigation. The journal concludes by discussing potential applications and future work that can be done in this field. Overall, this article highlights the importance of obstacle avoidance behavior for hexapod robots and the effectiveness of using Finite State Machine to model and control this behavior.

articleTitle: Multiplicative Random Number Generation Algorithm in Recognition of Hiragana Letters and Katakana Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper discusses the development of a multiplication-based random number generation algorithm to recognize Hiragana and Katakana letters in a game. The study aims to test the performance of the random number generation algorithm and measure its usability in a letter recognition game. The testing results across four game levels revealed the following accuracies: 84% for level 1, 84% for level 2, 82% for level 3, and 80% for level 4. The decline in performance across levels can be attributed to the similarity in the seed values generated by the game maker studio function, resulting in the same initial random number seed for calculations. This leads to the emergence of patterns that can affect letter recognition by players. Additionally, the usability testing involving 30 participants aged 14 and above yielded a usability score of 83.53%, indicating that the educational game for Hiragana and Katakana letter recognition falls into the category of highly usable. In conclusion, the multiplication-based random number generation algorithm used in the game demonstrates satisfactory results in recognizing Hiragana and Katakana letters. However, further improvements are necessary in managing the seed values to avoid the emergence of patterns that can impact the game’s quality.

articleTitle: The Blockchain Conceptual Model to Prevents Fraud and Increase Transparency In The Presidential Election In Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The presidential election in Indonesia is a national leadership change activity that is carried out every 5 years. Presidential election activities already have their own mechanisms, starting from the voting by citizens throughout Indonesia to the announcement of the results of the presidential election calculations. Voting by citizens is carried out at all polling places (TPS), and the votes acquired by the presidential candidate are counted. The calculation results are collected in stages up to the national level and converted into digital data. The problem is that there is no transparency in the vote counting system because there is no single party that can oversee the government’s vote counting system. The potential for fraud can occur considering there are hundreds of millions of voters with layered stages of collection and calculation. On the other hand, blockchain technology can display valid and transparent data. Thus, the aim of this research is to build a model for adopting blockchain technology for presidential elections in Indonesia. The research method uses a qualitative approach with several stages, such as identifying problems in conventional presidential elections, identifying features in the prototype, and building a model by considering the technicalities of blockchain adoption in the model. The main result of this research is a prototype for presidential elections using blockchain technology. By adopting blockchain technology in the Indonesian presidential election, it will increase the validity and transparency of voting results. In this way, all forms of fraud can be eliminated. The research results will also present examples of data simulations using blockchain technology and user interface designs for blockchain technology-based presidential election systems.

articleTitle: IoT-based Heartbeats Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)

authors.preferredName: Mohamad Asyraf Noorza Bin Mohd Tamron

abstract: The advent of the Internet of Things (loT) has opened up a realm of possibilities in developing globally accessible systems and devices. With the current state of internet speeds, these systems offer real-time control, making them more powerful than ever. Simultaneously, the healthcare sector has been witnessing notable advancements, but it also grapples with an increasing number of health issues, with heart problems standing out as a prominent concern in many countries. These problems manifest in various symptoms, some of which can lead to more serious conditions, such as irregular heartbeats. In response to these challenges and leveraging cutting-edge technology, researchers have embarked on endeavors to enhance healthcare devices and render them more readily available to medical professionals. This paper explores the merging of loT technology with healthcare, specifically focusing on the development of a system designed to monitor and record a patient’s heartbeat. This is achieved through the deployment of a Heartbeat/SpO2 Sensor, and the data is seamlessly transmitted to a mobile application accessible remotely. The outcomes of this study demonstrate that the heartbeat data captured by Arduino is effectively transmitted to the cloud, meeting the system’s predefined objectives. This represents a significant stride in harnessing loT’s potential to enhance healthcare practices and patient monitoring.

articleTitle: Improving User Experience Using User Experience Questionnaire Method on Online Attendance Super HANA Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Technological advancements have undergone a transformation and have had a significant impact on various aspects of our lives. Many companies nowadays use technology in their business operations, including PT Telkom Akses. Operating within the access network domain, PT Telkom Akses serves as a subsidiary of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia, contributing its expertise in this field. PT Telkom Akses has an application called Super HANA, which serves as an attendance system for all employees. However, based on user reviews, there are still some issues with the application. Some of these issues include user-unfriendly interface and errors in the attendance process. To assess the value of the Super HANA application and improve the user experience, User Experience testing is conducted using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) method and in-depth interviews. User Experience and User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) measurements are performed based on the aspects of attractiveness, efficiency, dependability, perspicuity, stimulation, and novelty. The analysis conducted using the UEQ Analysis Tools yielded the following average scores for the variable taps of UEQ: Attractiveness (2.20), Perspicuity (2.27), Efficiency (2.20), Dependability (1.97), Stimulation (2.03), and Novelty (2.19). Assessment is also carried out through in-depth interviews with employees to gather more detailed information about their experiences using the application. Based on the results of the questionnaire and interviews conducted, it can be concluded that the Super HANA application meets the satisfaction level of user experience. However, it still requires improvements and feature developments to support the attendance process for employees.

articleTitle: Analysis Sentiment towards Delivery Service: Case Study of Paxel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Paxel is an application-based delivery service. On Google Play, the Paxel application has been downloaded by more than 1 million users and has more than 10 thousand reviews. From the existing reviews, it will be more useful for the company if it can be processed properly. For this reason, a sentiment analysis was carried out to find out the sentiments of Paxel users, and the result can be used as a reference for improving Paxel services or products. The method used in this research is Random Forest, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). TF-IDF and SMOTE for data weighting and unbalance. As well as applying K-fold Cross Validation to evaluate the method used. As a result, the Random Forest method has a higher accuracy value of 91%, Naive Bayes 83%, and Support Vector Machine 87%. Where the F1-Score of the Random Forest method on the Positive Class is 89%, the Neutral Class is 93% and the Negative Class is 92%.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Digital Healthcare Website Using User Experience Questionnaire and Heuristic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Digital healthcare serves as a comprehensive platform that offers a multitude of functions. It facilitates telemedicine and virtual consultations. However, the bounce rate on the digital healthcare website remains high, where the bounce rate is one of the important indicators in assessing the quality of user experience. This study uses a combination of the methodology of User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) as a quantitative method and Heuristic Evaluation (HE) as a qualitative method to assess the usability, user satisfaction, and overall effectiveness of the healthcare website. UEQ and HE are vital for evaluating product satisfaction and usability. UEQ uses 26 questions to assess user experience, while HE relies on Nielsen’s 10 Usability Heuristics. These evaluations offer insights and guide improvements in user experience. Based on the opinions of 97 respondents and three evaluators, it can be concluded that the KlikDokter website achieves above-average scores in UEQ analysis and does not demonstrate a high level of severity for HE in its main business processes implemented on the website. This research contributes to the academic field by providing insights into digital healthcare websites and the utilization of UEQ and HE. These assessments play a pivotal role in improving website usability, ensuring users are engaged and satisfied. Consequently, this leads to reduced bounce rates and a more effective delivery of healthcare information and services to users.

articleTitle: Analyzing Code Injection Attacks on Applications of Android Devices and Emulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The Android operating system released by Google in 2007 has experienced very significant development. In 2019, the number of Android application users reached 2.5 billion. One of the contributing factors is the nature of the android application, which is very flexible and easy to install. Users can download APK files on the internet. Generally, APK files are stored in archive format, so they are pretty easy to manage. However, APK files may be used to spread malware behind this convenience. This study aims to provide an overview of the process of planting malware/backdoor on Android applications and how to prevent it. This study initiated the injection of malicious code on five android applications, namely WhatsApp, Telegram, DroidCam, Fifa Mobile, and Tokopedia. According to the results, four applications were successfully injected, while one application failed. The failure most likely occurred as a result of the application’s source code being obfuscated. Obfuscation is therefore strongly advised for Android applications to prevent code injection that could potentially lead to malware insertion.

articleTitle: The Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Land Surface Temperature Change through Remote Sensing Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Various fields can collaborate in analyzing specific phenomena, such as the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Most research tends to focus on one aspect of the discipline, such as economics, health, spread predictions, and the like. Given its impact not only on health but also on other aspects, this study utilizes the processing of spatial data derived from satellite imagery using Geographic Information System (GIS) to observe the impact of the pandemic phenomenon on environmental conditions, i.e., surface temperature warming in the city of Bekasi, Indonesia. This research utilizes GIS tools to convert Landsat 7 and Landsat 8 datasets by extracting thermal sensors (Band 10 and Band 11). The test results show an annual increase in temperature, but a decrease of approximately 10 degrees Celsius during the COVID-19 pandemic. This indicates the possibility of reducing temperature by reducing carbon usage as closely as possible to pandemic conditions.

articleTitle: Service Oriented Smart Model for Flood Controlling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Opening or closing dam-gate activities manually conducted in Manggarai dam to control the dam water level. The controlling action operated to avoid the flood possibility occurring in Jakarta city (the Indonesian capital). The study was conducted to develop a smart model for flood controlling based on service or called a service-oriented smart model (SOSM). The water-flow algorithm (WFA), fuzzy logic, object and service-oriented are four main methods operated in the study. The WFA is a central method to model the real water flow in the river coming from Katulampa dam (in Bogor city) until Manggarai dam (in Jakarta). The fuzzy logic functioned to simulate the dam’s water level and the gate open/close decision should be decided by avoiding the bias value. The object-oriented model analysis and design approach, where the unified modelling language (UML) tools are operated to analyze and design the constructed model. Then, the service-oriented conception is used to integrate all sides in implementing the model. Finally, the constructed model can simulate the flood status in Jakarta via status value in decimal numbers with 6 numbers behind the point.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Flow Meter Sensor for Genset Fuel Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the operation of a generator set, several problems are often encountered, one of which is the use of fuel where there is a difference in the volume of fuel filled into the tank and that used to operate the generator. Therefore, we need a monitoring system with sensor modules such as a flow meter sensor to calculate the capacity of the fuel loaded into the tank and the capacity of the fuel used or consumed by the generator set which has been integrated with the Internet of Things. This article describes the design and implementation of a generator fuel monitoring system. Two flowmeter sensors are placed at the fuel inlet and outlet of the generator tank. The test results for the two sensors showed an error value of 2.715% over 5 trials. The ESP8266 WiFi module’s loT integration allows to send sensor readings to the phpMyAdmin database and view the results in real-time via the web UI.

articleTitle: The Role of Sales Promotions and Customer Experience on Customer Satisfaction and Its Impacts on Online Shopping Repurchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Potential buyers are buyers who have an interest in buying the products or services offered by a business. This becomes important considering that the process of becoming an actual buyer starts with the awareness and interest of the prospective consumer in the product so that he has the intention to buy the product that the company offers. This study aims to determine how the effect of sales promotion and customer experience on repurchase intention through customer satisfaction. The research method used is a survey with the main questionnaire tool. The subjects of this research are customers who shop online at Blibli and purchased for a year. The sampling technique uses simple random sampling type. The data analysis technique used in this study is the path analysis method and assisted by SPSS as an analytical tool. The results of the study show that sales promotion and customer experience contribute to repurchase interest either directly or indirectly through customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Forward Chaining and Dempster Shafer Methods in Diagnosing Tonsillitis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In seven Indonesian provinces, tonsillitis is the third most common Ear, Nose, and Throat infection condition, affecting about 287,000 children under 15 worldwide. The patient experiences pain during examinations since clinicians still check the patient’s oral cavity directly for extended periods. As a result, we require a system that will aid medical professionals in identifying and explaining tonsillitis to patients. The Forward Chaining and Dempster Shafer Techniques are combined in the system that was developed. The Dempster Shafer calculates the prediction results, and the Forward Chaining technique categorizes diseases following expert guidelines. A total of 75 data points from medical records were included in the test. System diagnostic testing produced an accuracy rating of 94.6% compared to expert diagnostics.

articleTitle: Does Deflate Outperform Huffman Lossless Compression?
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)

authors.preferredName: I Dewa Agung Kayana Abhipraya Putra Bandjar
authors.firstName: I Dewa Agung Kayana Abhipraya Putra

abstract: Lossless compression is a compression technique used to store data with higher quality compared to its counterpart, lossy compression. This study explores two specific lossless compression techniques to investigate and address the research questions that motivated this experiment. Deflate, an algorithm derived from Huffman and LZ77, is one of the techniques under examination. This algorithm is particularly intriguing due to the amalgamation of the two preceding compression techniques. Consequently, a crucial inquiry arises: does Deflate surpass its original algorithm? In this paper, Huffman and Deflate are compared to analyze whether combining algorithms yields superior or inferior results. The conducted test provides evidence supporting the superiority of Deflate over Huffman. Deflate demonstrates advantages in terms of compression ratio and, notably, compression and decompression speed. However, it is important to note that this case is not conclusively closed, as the experiment can still be extended to include other algorithms. The present paper exclusively focuses on Deflate and does not guarantee that all combination-based algorithms outperform the algorithms they incorporate. Nevertheless, this comparative analysis makes a valuable contribution to the future development of lossless compression techniques. Additionally, it fulfills the objective of understanding the factors that enable an algorithm like Deflate to effectively implement multiple compression techniques.

articleTitle: Development Based on Mobile Application for Learning Mandarin Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Mandarin is being learned more and more over the years due to globalization. This has led some people to develop learning media to learn this language. One of the learning media that we usually see is YouTube, courses, and learning apps. Many Chinese learning apps are found only learning vocabulary, writing, and grammar. Learning Chinese requires an understanding of intonation and pronunciation as mistakes in pronunciation can lead to misunderstanding and meaning. Therefore, this research aims to help someone in learning Chinese vocabulary, writing, grammar, intonation, and pronunciation. The system is developed on mobile to provide convenience and flexibility. This application is called WilChinese. this application is evaluated using blackbox and UAT (User Acceptance Test). this application has been tested with a series of blackbox tests have passed while for UAT 92% of respondents are satisfied using this application to learn mandarin. These results make the application can be a solution to solve problems and challenges that are often faced when learning Mandarin.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Risk Model for Research and Development Department in Clinical Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Information security risk is of utmost importance and a crucial concern, particularly within a clinical laboratory responsible for managing sensitive public health information. Various endeavors have been undertaken by institutions to tackle this pressing challenge effectively. This research seeks to develop a computer-based decision model for assessing information security risks. The model is scientifically constructed using the fuzzy logic method as its core approach and designed through an object-oriented approach. Impressively, the model successfully simulates 31 risk scenarios with an accuracy rate of 93.55%.

articleTitle: Usability Evaluation of Mobile Travoy Application Using the System Usability Scale (SUS) Method (Case Study: PT Jasamarga Tollroad Operator)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to evaluate the usability of the Travoy mobile application using the System Usability Scale (SUS) method. The data analysis method used is SUS, which involves 10 questions with 5 answer choices. Based on the conducted survey, the majority of respondents were women (52%) and men (48%). The usability evaluation shows that the overall score of the Travoy application is 63, equivalent to a grade of C-. Although this application is acceptable to users, to achieve better acceptance, a minimum score of 68 needs to be attained. In terms of the adjective interpretation approach, this application can still be categorized as “OK” with sufficient level of acceptance. Based on the Net Promoter Score (NPS) interpretation approach, the Travoy application falls into the “passive” category, where users neither reject nor have a strong desire to use the service. The results of the interview with users indicate that the user interface (UI) design needs to be improved for a better user experience, especially in the toll rate feature, digital receipt feature, and the addition of HD in the CCTV feature.

articleTitle: Design and Build AAA Server using Free Radius Study Case Network Security Management at PT. XYZ
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service (RADIUS) is a network protocol that can provide centralized authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) management to connected users. A network Access Server (NAS) was used in this protocol to authorize users’ access to different network resources. Company XYZ has been managing their network resources using IP and device-based allocation. While this is enough, issues will come sooner or later if the network resource allocation management is not centralized. Also because of the company’s mobile culture, current security policy implementation faces issues as the user is not tightly monitored and the effort to maintain multiple firewall configurations and policies is high. This solution applied the right security policy to the correct users and minimized the IT staff effort required to manage the network resources. Of the three implementation scenarios carried out, RADIUS was successfully integrated into all three, namely Work from Office (WFO) users’ integration, Work from anywhere (WFA) users’ integration using SSL VPN, and firewall administrator. This centralized user management and speeded up the user management process for PT. XYZ multiple firewalls into a three-minute process while also improving the visibility for the network resources users.

articleTitle: Database Implementation using Citus on Telecommunication Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has always related to the data collection and processing according to business needs and requirements. This data serves as an important source of information stored in a database and to be displayed in an information system. Along with the advancement of information technology, the demand for faster and larger data processing has become a challenge faced by many industries especially in the Telecommunications field. Therefore, an efficient database system is needed to handle the increasing volume of data, using storage methods such as distributed database and columnar storage to improve data processing performance and reduce its size. The use of these storage methods needs to be empirically and comparatively evaluated. This research uses K6 testing framework on the PostgreSQL database. The result indicates that the use of PostgreSQL database with distributed database and columnar storage methods can increase query processing performance in the database by 48.2% faster for select query commands, decrease by 3.3% for insert query command and 74.6% reduction of table storage size compared to PostgreSQL without these methods. Hence, the use of these storage methods is highly suitable and recommended for implementation in industries that requires fast and large-scale data processing such as Telecommunication Industry.

articleTitle: Green Building Assessment Based on Appropriate Site Development and Water Conservation Category at Building B Nusa Putra University
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Green building is an initiative aimed at reducing the impact of global warming. Green buildings can serve as a sustainable development concept. As a higher education institution, Nusa Putra University (UNsP) is responsible for setting an example in sustainability practices in the midst of infrastructure development. This study aims to provide an assessment and recommendations based on the concept of green building on greenship criteria for new buildings version 1.2, especially in the category of Appropriate Site Development (ASD) and Water Conservation (WAC) in Building B, Nusa Putra University. The analysis was conducted with field observations and interviews with the management of Building B, Nusa Putra University. Based on the assessment that has been done in two categories, Appropriate Site Development gets 3 points out of 17 points or 17.64% and Water Conservation gets 0 points. An evaluation is needed for Nusa Putra University Building B, especially the two categories that are assessed based on the greenship standard. Recommendations made to increase Green Building points in the Appropriate Site Development (ASD) and Water Conservation (WAC) categories are providing bus stops in front of the campus gate, providing parking lots for bicycle users, planning the use of technology to reduce water runoff discharge, providing rainwater harvesting tanks, utilizing alternative water such as ablution water and air conditioning condensation water.

articleTitle: Revitalizing the UI/UX Design of Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park Website through Design Thinking Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park, located in the East Java province, represents one of the largest volcanic areas in the region. Notably, it stands as the sole conservation area in Indonesia featuring a 10km sea of sand and a diverse array of tourist attractions. However, the existing website of Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park requires improvements in terms of its user interface and user experience, aiming to provide a more contemporary and visually appealing presentation of the park’s attractions. To address this, the design thinking methodology is adopted as a framework for the design stages, accompanied by qualitative research methods. Data collection involved the utilization of questionnaires and interviews, while usability testing was conducted to assess the website’s usability. Valuable suggestions and feedback from users played a pivotal role in informing the design process of the Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park website.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis of BAZNAS Jombang Website Using User Experience Questionnaire
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the user experience satisfaction of donors who use the Jombang National Zakat Agency (BAZNAS) website. Judging from the comparison of the difference between the number of BAZNAS Jombang donors and the number of donors using the Jombang BAZNAS website. This research method uses the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) by distributing a survey via a questionnaire form to 100 respondents. Based on the evaluation results, it is known that the evaluation score for the attractiveness aspect was 1.315 (positive), the perspicuity aspect scored 1.263 (positive), the efficiency aspect scored 1.260 (positive), the dependability aspect scored 1.308 (positive), the stimulation aspect scored 1.160 (positive), and the novelty aspect scored 0.798 (neutral). This indicates that although the website makes a strong first impression and is straightforward, effective, reliable, and inspiring, it is still out of date and appears boring and traditional, thus it must be fixed. The novelty aspect of the website can be improved by updating it frequently to keep it from seeming monotonous. Updates can take the form of display changes or website features. Then, based on the findings of follow-up interviews, donors hope that the text of prayer support or intentions will be displayed before payment to make it simpler for donors to make donation payments.

articleTitle: Analysis of Edlink User Satisfaction Using Pieces Framework (Case Study: University X)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Edlink is a cutting-edge educational tool to assist students, lecturers, and professors in learning. It was developed by the country’s youth in 2019. This study uses the PIECES Framework technique to ascertain how satisfied University X Information System students are with Edlink. Data was collected through a survey with respodents of 166 Information System student class of 2022. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is employed to analyze the data, and SmartPLS 4 is the tool of choice. The result of the Composite Reliability calculation is that all variables are valid for use and get a satisfactory value. Five variables positively affect satisfaction, namely control and security variables, with a value of 0.016,economics 0.118, efficiency 0.235, information and data 0.215, and service 0.405. One variable has a negative influence, namely the Performance variable, with a value of -0.033. The results of the Convergent Validation testing of all indicators were declared valid, and the bootstrapping calculation process was carried out; it can be concluded that there is 1 hypothesis was rejected; namely the Performance hypothesis, and five other hypotheses were accepted.

articleTitle: The Study of Space Circulation on IKEA Kreativ Application for Sustainable Business in Furniture Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In 2022, IKEA launched the IKEA Kreativ application as a development of its furniture sales strategy by presenting an interactive design experience through artificial intelligence (AI) technology. An excellent digital interior 3D drawing certainly still requires designer knowledge, especially in function and not just the aesthetic aspects. Applying Information, Communication and Technology (ICT) as part of the marketing strategy will positively impact and support the sales of IKEA products. Adapting to the community's needs through IKEA Kreativ is a consistency of IKEA's business development in interpreting its main concepts, such as ideas and practice concepts.
