This research found that this application has minimal information related to standard circulation needed by humans as users. The clearance space shown in the application did not have a measurement. Ergonomics is a primary aspect of creating space, and it also needs to be applied in digital space. It gives appropriate areas for human mobility in their daily activities. This research will focus on the IKEA Kreativ that aims to give experience to the user and support customers in deciding on the type of furniture based on their circumstances. By developing technology-based digital applications, IKEA has continuously improved their services and supported sustainable business in the retail furniture industry.

articleTitle: Designing an IoT-Based Information System for Improving Efficiency and Productivity in Small-Scale Manufacturing Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) had become a focus in the manufacturing industry. The presence of IoT technology was expected to address challenges in efforts to improve efficiency and productivity in the production process in both small-scale and large-scale manufacturing industries. In this research, using the problems that existed in small-scale manufacturing industries, the problems often faced were material delays, absent operators, and machines that could not operate. In this research, we designed an information system that included system architecture, use case diagrams, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and mockup applications. Our focus was on the information system for processes in the production line, where each machine used was equipped with IoT devices along with power and vibration measuring sensors. From this design, it was expected to help manufacturing companies in creating an information system for collecting data related to the production machines used. So that in the future it could be used in making business process decisions for the company.

articleTitle: Enhancing Waste Management and Air Quality through Dual Chamber Incinerator with Filtration for Electrical Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research endeavors to revolutionize waste management and air quality enhancement by introducing a cutting-edge approach: the utilization of a dual chamber incinerator integrated with advanced filtration mechanisms for the generation of electrical energy. The increasing waste accumulation and escalating air pollution pose substantial environmental challenges globally. This study addresses these issues by proposing an innovative solution that not only transforms waste into a valuable energy resource but also mitigates harmful air pollutants. The research method involves the development and optimization of a dual chamber incinerator, which promotes efficient combustion and minimizes emission of pollutants. Rigorous filtration systems are integrated to further reduce air pollutants and particulate matter. The results reveal a significant reduction in waste volume, alongside the successful generation of electrical energy. The concurrent reduction in air pollutants showcases the effectiveness of the filtration system in enhancing air quality. This research thus contributes to sustainable waste management practices and environmental preservation by offering a viable strategy for waste-to-energy conversion while ameliorating air quality concerns.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis Using Usability Testing Method on Online Queue System at Hospital Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Region Public Hospital as a public health service provider, has an online queue system using mobile application, called Si Poetri which is used by patients to register for outpatient services. The main purpose of this study is to analyze the user experience of Si Poetri application, including user difficulties when using the application using Usability measurement aspect. Based on observations from user assessment (ratings and reviews) of Si Poetri Application on Google Play store, some of the problems presented in the form of difficulty finding menus for patient registration, unable to access some features, navigation that is not user-friendly because there is absence of user manual. The research conducted to measure the User Experience of Si Poetri application refers to the five components of Usability Testing. From the results of analysis of questionnaire data testing using SmartPLS application, it was found that design improvements were needed, especially in the variables Learnability, Efficiency, and Memorability of the usability components that affect the user experience of the application, so that improvements were made to the application design to increase user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Prototype Urban Farming Assistant (WUFARM) using Web of Things for Family Food Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of WUFARM, a Web of Things (WoT) based prototype for urban farming, with the primary objective of improving household food security. The research methodology involves several steps. Firstly, the control system architecture is designed, comprising temperature sensors (DHT22) and humidity sensors (Capactive Soil Moisture) connected to the ESP32 microcontroller. Secondly, relays are utilized to establish a connection between the microcontroller and the DC water pump. Additionally, the device is connected to a server via the internet to monitor and control the temperature and humidity levels inside the greenhouse. Testing is conducted by monitoring the temperature and humidity values and activating the cooling fan and irrigation pump based on predetermined parameters. The temperature and humidity data collected by the device are transmitted to the Thingspeak cloud platform, allowing for visualization in the form of graphs and tables. The integration of IoT and the Thingspeak platform enables remote monitoring and control through smartphones or computers. The implementation of WUFARM in urban farming aims to optimize family food production, reduce reliance on external food supply, and address post-pandemic challenges in food sustainability. Testing is carried out to ensure the performance of the system, and the results are visualized through the Thingspeak platform.

articleTitle: Digital Payment Experience at Coffee Shop: Customers Satisfaction and Repurchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This analysis examines the influence of digital payment experience at coffee shops and store atmosphere on customer satisfaction and repurchase intentions. The study hypothesis was tested employing a Structural Equation Model (SEM) technique based on Partial Least Square (PLS) based on components or variants. The results show that the digital payment experience significantly and positively influences customer satisfaction and repurchase intention. Similarly, store atmosphere positively and significantly influences customer satisfaction and repurchase intention. Finally, customer satisfaction positively and significantly influences repurchase intentions. Research shows that modern coffee shops with a comfortable and unique store atmosphere can get customer satisfaction and repurchase intention.

articleTitle: Football Supporters Club Opinion Analysis using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In this study, we conducted a sentiment analysis of the opinions of football club supporters using the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) algorithm with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). We adopted the best model for each club to predict the sentiments expressed on social media Twitter. The experimental results show that using the RNN algorithm with LSTM produces excellent accuracy in analyzing the opinions of football club supporters. In the Arsenal dataset, accuracy reaches 80% with a training data sharing scheme of 90% and 10% testing. The accuracy of the Liverpool club dataset reaches 82% with the same data-sharing scheme. Meanwhile, on the Manchester United club dataset, this algorithm also achieves 80% accuracy with a similar data-sharing scheme. These findings indicate that applying the RNN modeling technique with LSTM is very effective in analyzing the opinions of football club supporters on social media platforms. These sentiment results can provide valuable insights for these clubs to better understand their supporters’ feelings and views.

articleTitle: Rule-based Approach for Air Quality Monitoring System with Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Air pollution that continues to increase can cause several health problems, one of which is respiratory problems. Some of the air pollutants that are often found include particles or dust, carbon monoxide (CO), sodium dioxide (NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>). Even though at certain times humans can feel whether the air around them is good or not by using their sense of smell, to do this continuously, humans are still limited by space and time. This study uses the Internet of things to conduct real-time monitoring and obtain data regarding indoor air quality. The sensors used are the MQ-7, MQ-135, and the GP2Y10101AU0F sensor which is a sensor in the microcontroller to detect 3 pollution parameters including CO,NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and dust contained in the air. The analog voltage obtained by the sensor is then processed by the microcontroller into CO, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and dust data. Rule-based is used to categorize air quality into 5 categories, namely good, moderate, unhealthy, very unhealthy and dangerous.

articleTitle: Network Anomaly Detection Analysis using Artillery Honeypot and Wazuh SIEM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Cybercrime attacks are difficult to detect because when they occur, irresponsible parties can exploit the system or user information. The most common attack threats are malware, brute force/password cracking, information gathering, Denial of Service (DDoS), SQL Injection, and cross-site scripting. This research was conducted to design IPS Honeypot Artillery technology to improve the performance of the security system and use SIEM Wazuh as an analysis based on event logs by conducting test methods based on the most frequent attacks to block unnatural traffic through IPS Honeypot Artillery. After implementing Honeypot and Wazuh, various attacks can be detected and monitored through SIEM Wazuh so that Honeypot Artillery can mitigate them by blocking the attacking IP address. The implementation of a server-based security system using Honeypot Artileri and SIEM Wazuh has been successfully implemented, so that it can be a solution to increase security from attacks and help network administrators to find out information patterns and attack techniques that occur so that they can follow up on these attacks.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Android-Based Food Sharing Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Food wastage problem is becoming an increasingly pressing issue. Food sharing concept is one of many ways that could be effective to overcome this problem. Food sharing is a concept in which food that is still up for consumption are distributed for those in need, so that it can reduce food wastage. The purpose of this research is to design and develop an Android-based food sharing application. Data collection method in this research was using questionnaire and literature study regarding the development of food sharing application called FShare. System development using waterfall method. System design method using the Unified Modeling Language. Database design using the Entity Relationship Diagram. Black box testing for evaluation and the Eight Golden Rules for interface evaluation. The application brings together food donor with receiver in need. The result of this research is that an application has been made with features such as donating and receiving food with verification, location tracking on a map with GPS, and report feature for reporting food-related problems. From the system and interface evaluation that carried out towards the application, it can be concluded that the application has getting status that is in accordance with expected function and the application is in line with the Eight Golden Rules.

articleTitle: Design of IoT-Based Electrical Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Currently, most of the monitoring of electrical energy usage in buildings is carried out manually. The implementation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology is essential for efficient and effective electrical energy usage monitoring. In this paper, we present the design of an IoT-based electrical energy meter and an SOA-based electrical energy monitoring service system platform. The IoT-based electrical energy meter utilizes ESP32 and a digital power meter with Modbus RS485 capability, enabling it to measure current, voltage, frequency, power factor, power, and energy. The research methodology in this paper consists of three stages. It begins with a literature review on electrical energy consumption monitoring from previous studies, followed by the design and testing of an IoT-based electrical energy meter. This paper provides a design for an IoT-based electrical energy meter and a service framework that could prove valuable for future research in establishing a service system platform for electrical energy monitoring.

articleTitle: A Ranking-Based Feature Selection For Indoor Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The indoor positioning system is a service that is quite popular because it is used in many applications. Research in this field with various approaches continues to develop to get the best results in detecting the user’s location. One technique used to solve this problem is machine learning with many algorithms. However, this technique was still developed to produce high accuracy and low computation time. This study utilizes ranking-based feature selection techniques before the data process by machine learning algorithms. Feature selection was implemented to reduce the existing dataset to improve accuracy and reduce the computation time. We use the ujiindoorloc dataset with 520 access point RSSI and 2 (two) coordinates. Based on experimental results, the results show that applying ranking-based feature selection techniques can increase the computational speed and accuracy of the resulting classification. In this article, the feature selection algorithm used is information gain, gain ratio, random, and chi-square. We use J48 and a naive Bayes classification algorithm to test the reduced dataset. The results show that the accuracy and computational speed increase after the implementation of feature selection compared to the random feature selection and full dataset. The computational time was increased by 2.58 seconds to 1.72 for the Naive Bayes algorithm and 43.84 to 10.57 for the J48 algorithm for the best result. In contrast, the accuracy increased by 1% compared to the whole dataset.

articleTitle: Green E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: At present, the e-commerce sector is characterised by rapidly increasing volumes of parcel deliveries, causing congestion, noise and air pollution in public spaces. The number of CEPs is also increasing due to more partial deliveries, multiple delivery attempts and a high number of returns. According to the "eCommerce Study Austria", the return rate for the year 2020 will be over 40 percent. Increased freight transport on the last mile will lead to more congestion, noise and emissions. On the demand side, online shops often offer no or only very limited climate-friendly delivery options, which contradicts the growing sustainability awareness of many end customers. The design, development and evaluation of technological, behavioural and logistical interventions will address these gaps. The Green eCommerce project aims to enable online customers to make their deliveries more sustainable and to increase their awareness of sustainable goods transport through technological (Al-based chatbot, 3D fitting tool), behavioural (playful reward system, persuasive design patterns) and logistical (choice of e-transport) innovations. In particular, the aim is to minimise returns and multiple home delivery attempts, and to encourage bulk ordering and direct delivery of regional products. The extension of existing online shops with these innovative and modular components represents a novelty in the sense that traffic avoidance, traffic optimisation and modal shift can be achieved through the behaviour of online customers. Compared to current measures in freight logistics (e.g. route optimisation, electrification of the fleet, construction of hubs), this persuasive approach aimed at the end consumer has hardly been researched. This package of measures is currently being implemented in three online shops and evaluated in terms of acceptance, usability and environmental impact.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on JIBAS Computer Based Exam Application Using Usability Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: JIBAS Computer Based Exam is a mobile-based exam application created by Yayasan Indonesia Baca. This study analyzes and evaluates the User Experience (UX) in JIBAS Computer Based Exam (CBE) application. Usability testing and System Usability Scale (SUS) methods have been used to obtain the results. This application has 1,5 of 5,0 ratings on Google Play Store. The study participants were students who used the application. Through observations and SUS questionnaires, qualitative and quantitative data were collected and analyzed. The result identify the app’s strengths and weaknesses, and provide suggestions for improvements to improve the user experience. The average SUS is 65.9, a low level of satisfaction with the usability of the application. This study contributes to the development of JIBAS CBE by considering UX and system usability and can be used as a guideline for the improvement of these applications and usability testing of other computer-based applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Tooth Enumeration on Panoramic Radiographs Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Accurate tooth numbering is essential for dental procedures, treatment planning, and patient record management. Automatic tooth enumeration in dental panoramic radiographs is crucial in modern dental image analysis and diagnosis. Tooth enumeration in panoramic radiographs has relied on handcrafted features and traditional image processing techniques. Still, these methods often lack the accuracy and robustness required for complex cases and varied image qualities. Despite the advancements in deep learning-based object detection algorithms, a significant research gap remains in the specific domain of automatic tooth enumeration on panoramic radiographs. This research paper presents an innovative approach for automatic tooth enumeration on panoramic radiographs using the state-of-the-art You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection framework focused on implementing the YOLOv5 library. The YOLOv5 model is evaluated as an efficient system capable of accurately detecting and enumerating individual teeth from panoramic radiographs. The 612 panoramic radiograph images evaluation shows the bounding-box results show the best tooth detection rate in the YOLOv5x model. The YOLOv5 model is generally very good at predicting tooth enumeration on panoramic radiographs in a relatively small dataset. This advancement is expected to enhance dental diagnosis and treatment planning, benefiting dental professionals and patients.

articleTitle: Fluid Geometric: An Experimentation of Designing Flexible Multi-Style Typeface Using Variable Font
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Variable font is the newest font file specification that was born to adapt to the digital media environment-as almost all design products today developed toward a screen-based and responsive nature to conform to the fast-changing technology. The variable font is addressed to opens many flexibilities in the design of the typeface. However, the research on this subject is still very limited. It is regrettable since the possibilities are wide open, and the variable font itself is the future of the type design industry. One of the main aspects of variable font is the shape interpolation feature which enables shape morphing in a single font file. In this research, there will be an experiment to design a variable font with two contrasting characteristics, which are geometric and organic. It is meant to test the flexibility in the shape interpolation feature and to examine the process of shape morphing. At the end of the research, it is known that the adjustments of the master, instances, and axes play a crucial part in the design process of a variable font. The main finding of the research is the number of the master is the key to producing a smooth morphing shape. All in all, the two extreme characters such as geometric and organic shapes are possible to be combined well in a single font file, resulting in a fluid geometric shape. In this research, it is proven that variable font is revolutionary in terms of giving designers to flexibility to add value to their design and shows that a fluid geometric typeface can exist.

articleTitle: Advancing Predicting Heart Disease: A Comparative Study of SVM, Naive Bayes, KNN, Linear Regression, and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The heart is one of the most essential organs in the human body, working as the major pump for the blood that passes through the veins of the body, transporting energy and nutrients needed for the body to function. However, even though it is also one of the most protected organs in a human body, it is not exactly free from threats like diseases, malfunctions, etc. as it can still be damaged by various factors. As such, this research was made to detect the existence of heart diseases that might affect the functionality of the organ itself, by using various features to be used in an experiment where it involves multiple models with hyperparameter tuning with hyperparameters that we consider to be the best for each model used from our experiment in addition with experiment using LSTM and KNN in order to determine whether or not a patient has a cardiac condition. The experiment done by this research has gained quite a result, utilizing techniques like Hyperparameter optimization to find the best performing model, which was found to be tuned KNN with gain accuracy of 91.85%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Plastic Detection and Classification: Advancing Recognition of Plastic Varieties Using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The widespread use of plastics in everyday life has caused serious problems related to the management of plastic waste. Problems related to knowledge about the types of plastics, namely PET/PETE (Polyetylene Terephthalate), HDPE (Hight density polyethylene), PVC (Polyvinyl chloride), LDPE (Low density polyethlene), PP (Polyethylene), PS (Polyethlene) and Other (O) arise due to a lack of understanding of the different types of plastic and how to identify them. This knowledge is especially important in the context of sustainable plastic waste management. In an effort to address this challenge, object detection and classification technologies are gaining increasing attention in the recognition and management of various types of plastics. This paper proposes a detection and classification approach to identify 7 (seven) types of plastic that are commonly used using object detection techniques, with a focus on using YOLO (You Only Look Once) v8, a new method in computer vision. The proposed method is implemented by utilizing the YOLOv8 architecture, YOLOv8 is the latest version which has several improvements and advantages for recognizing and distinguishing objects including types of plastic in image form. The dataset covering a wide variety of plastics is used as the basis for training detection and classification models. The results of the experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed approach in recognizing and classifying plastics based on their visual features.

articleTitle: Browser Preference Prediction for Computer Users using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Using machine learning techniques to predict people’ preferred web browsers has become a powerful way to improve user experience and personalize web browsing. In a time where social media interactions are a part of everyday life, it is critical to recognize and accommodate personal preferences. This study presents the Random Forest algorithm as the selected approach and investigates the role of prediction in web browser preference. The system provides a tailored and efficient surfing experience by utilizing user information to anticipate browser preferences. The experimental findings highlight the model’ s predictive power with a noteworthy accuracy rate of 96.2 percent. This high accuracy suggests that the model is able to recognize and accommodate the individual preferences of users. The predictive model has a great deal of promise for practical uses with its level of accuracy, making it an invaluable resource for marketers, user experience designers, and web developers. By employing the insights gained from this study, practitioners can better tailor their services to individual users, contributing to an improved browsing experience in everyday life. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Identification of Sukun (Artocarpus altilis) and Kluwih (Artocarpus camansi) Leaves using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: It’s critical to correctly identify Sukun (Artocarpus altilis) and Kluwih (Artocarpus camansi) leaves to avoid misunderstandings about their traditional medical use and to prevent fraud in the sale of plant seedlings. This study uses the well-known deep-learning algorithms VGG16 and Inception v3 to identify Sukun and Kluwih leaves. A varied collection of leaf photos in a range of sizes was gathered and used in the experiment. The results of the experiment demonstrate how profoundly useful deep learning is at identifying leaves. A remarkable accuracy rate of 99.52 percent was demonstrated by the VGG16 and Inception v3 models. The models’ dependability for practical, real-world applications is highlighted by this level of accuracy. Due to the excellent accuracy attained by both models, it can be concluded that they are suitable for practical applications such as preventing the improper use of leaves and preventing potential fraud in the trading of plant saplings. The work underlines the viability of adopting these models to address relevant societal concerns while showcasing the promise of deep learning approaches in botanical classification.

articleTitle: Drivers and Barriers of Cloud Accounting Adoption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by these complex supply chains, businesses are turning to Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions that leverage cloud accounting. However, because cloud accounting relies on Industry 4.0 technologies, it is perceived as an expensive endeavor that necessitates a complete overhaul of existing business processes. This perception has led to hesitation among companies, especially those in developing countries, to invest in cloud accounting technology without clear and promising benefits and incentives. This paper’s primary objective is to identify both the drivers that encourage and the barriers that hinder the adoption of cloud accounting. This knowledge can help companies and policymakers understand how to address these challenges effectively or provide the necessary incentives to promote adoption. Intriguingly, it is observed that for each identified barrier, corresponding drivers that could potentially mitigate these obstacles are also present. This finding suggests a disconnect between academic research and its practical application in the industry. In light of this disconnection, the paper emphasizes the need for future research to focus on bridging the gap between academia and industry. Furthermore, it suggests that future studies should explore the relationship between these drivers and barriers and their impact on a company’s performance. Ultimately, the paper underscores the importance of understanding the dynamics of cloud accounting adoption to harness its full potential for businesses in this rapidly evolving technological landscape.

articleTitle: Recent Trends for Text Summarization in Scientific Documents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Text summarization is a natural language processing (NLP) technique in artificial intelligence that has been studied in recent years. Every document containing text is tested to get a good summary result. In producing a good summary, proper accuracy is required; therefore, various techniques and methods are used, and another challenge is the use of language in the documents being tested. Various types of documents have been used as research for text summarization, including scientific documents, so researchers are interested in studying them more intensely to get the state of the art in research. This research was conducted to review previous research using literature studies from various publications that published research on text summarization in scientific documents. The researcher collected data from several publishers who had published this type of research from 1988 to 2023 quarter 1 and obtained three hundred and eleven articles, then the researcher analyzed the data using the Kitchenham method to get the right literature to answer the research question. Thirty-seven articles were selected for further in-depth analysis. In addition, the researcher found some interesting findings beyond the research question, including other techniques used to solve the text summarization problem and other types of output that are not commonly produced so that it can increase knowledge in researching text summarization.

articleTitle: Exploring the Application of Augmented Reality in Mathematics Education: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study focuses on exploring the differences in Augmented Reality (AR)-based mathematical studies. To address these differences, the research will conduct a systematic literature review (SLR) summarizing AR applications in math learning from 2013 to April 2022. The review specifically considers education levels, material topics, and areas of ability, including mental activities. The search terms used are augmented reality, math, mathematics, and education. Out of 486 initially identified articles, 37 were deemed relevant based on title, abstract, and content filters, and were used as samples. The study reveals that AR has been implemented across all education levels, with a higher suitability observed in elementary school. Geometry and function emerge as the most commonly addressed topics using AR. Additionally, AR demonstrates suitability in developing cognitive aspects. The findings aim to offer a clearer understanding of how and why AR is used in the context of learning mathematics.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Indonesian New Capitol (IKN) on Twitter Using Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The objective of this research is to examine the viewpoints of users on Twitter’s social media platform with regards to the proposed development plans for Ibu Kota Nusantara. It aims to determine whether these users hold negative, positive, or neutral opinions on the matter. The data is collected by means of data scraping, focusing specifically on information related to ’Ibu Kota Nusantara’. The chosen method for analysis is the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm, utilizing both linear and sigmoid kernels, as well as the Naïve Bayes Classifier and Random Forest. The sentiment analysis is performed by comparing the performance metrics of each classification algorithm. The results indicate a positive sentiment of 38.67%, negative sentiment of 12.94%, and neutral sentiment of 48.39%. The evaluation of the system involves the use of a confusion matrix to obtain four accuracy values. Firstly, the SVM with a linear kernel achieves an accuracy of 89.77%, a precision value of 87.36%, and a recall value of 85.62%. Secondly, the SVM with a sigmoid kernel demonstrates an accuracy of 88.69%, a precision value of 87.39%, and a recall value of 83.94%. Thirdly, the Naïve Bayes classifier attains an accuracy of 79.26%, a precision value of 76.19%, and a recall value of 76.19%. Finally, the Random Forest algorithm yields an accuracy of 66.88%, a precision value of 84.42%, and a recall value of 49.33%. In conclusion, it can be observed that the linear kernel SVM outperforms the other classification algorithms in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Behavioral Intention to Use Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard as Digital Payment Methods: A Moderator of Ownership
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research aims to determine performance expectancy and effort expectancy towards behavioral intention towards using the Quick Response Code Indonesia Standard (QRIS) payment method influenced by business ownership. The data was collected using an online questionnaire to night culinary MSMEs in the Bandung area, a culinary center in Indonesia. IBM SPSS and partial least square structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) is a Techniques for analyzing data in this research. As a result, Performance Expectancy and effort expectancy significantly positively impact behavioral intention in using the Quick Response Code Indonesia Standard (QRIS) payment method influenced by business ownership. MSMEs culinary nights in the Bandung area need support from a QRIS payment method provider company and the government. The aim is to provide facilities and education to take advantage of the QRIS payment method, including socialization factors, education, and assistance with facilities such as the internet that are adequate to use the Quick Response Code Indonesia Standard (QRIS) payment method.

articleTitle: Purchase Intention of E-Commerce Platform in Indonesia: Determinants of the Motivation Hindering Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This research identifies the antecedents contributing to consumers’ willingness to purchase e-commerce in Indonesia. This study aims to examine the influence of factors such as security, privacy, reputation, and customer attitude on e-commerce purchase intention in Indonesia. The research adopts a quantitative approach, conducting an online survey involving 320 respondents from across Indonesia. The Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) method is employed for data analysis, with SmartPLS 4.0 used as the statistical tool to examine the correlations among variables. The findings of this study indicate that factors such as security, privacy, and reputation positively impact customer attitude and purchase intention, while perceived risk has a negative impact. This research provides new insights for e-commerce in Indonesia to enhance antecedents such as security, privacy, and reputation to influence consumers’ positive attitudes and purchase intention. Moreover, this study offers practical and theoretical insights that elevate our understanding and facilitate strategy development within Indonesia’s rapidly expanding digital sectors.

articleTitle: Behavioral Intention to Use Audit Software using DeLone-McLean and Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the industrial era 4.0, the work of auditors has become increasingly complex. Auditors can no longer rely solely on manual work methods, but must have switched to working using audit software. However, there are still many auditors who do not use software or use software, but their use is still very limited to basic functions. This is what made us organize a study to examine the factors that determine the auditor’s intention to use audit software. We use a combination of two theories, namely DeLone-McLean and the Technology Acceptance Model to predict these factors. The object of our research is auditors who work in the Jakarta Greater Area. We use statistical analysis of structural equation modeling partial least squares (SEM PLS). The results of our study state that information quality, system quality, perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use have a significant effect on the auditor’s intention to use audit software. On the other hand, service quality has no significant effect. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Transformation in Design Education Learning To Support The Sustainability of Tourism Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: During the pandemic era, there has been a sharp increase in online activity in the world of education as well as changes in the teaching system which tend to be hybrid, which also has an impact on learning strategies in the interior design study program. Before the pandemic, the teaching system and materials in the Interior Design study program relied heavily on physical and visual interactions that required sensory experiences to feel various atmospheres in a room. However, during the pandemic, the experience was not conduct optimally, so it required technological support to accelerate the learning process to become more effective and interactive. To explore more information, this study conducts literature review and field research in the tourism area as a project case study. This study also applies interactive technology approach to implement the integration of various technologies to gain insights from direct experience and to contribute to both theoretical understanding and practical improvements within the field. This study focuses on the implementation of digital learning packed with features to conduct distance learning and training in a live and immersive environment. With the implementation of digital transformation through technology support and user-friendly platform applications in design learning systems, it is expected that it can accelerate the process of technological literacy and the delivery of teaching materials that are more interactive and can be accessed more flexible from many locations.

articleTitle: The Comparison Of Lexicon-Based And Support Vector Machine Methods For Online Loan Sentiment Analysis On Twitter Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The development of online lending has led to many reactions, opinions, discussions, and public debates on various social media, including Twitter. Different things conveyed through Twitter Tweets can be used to determine how social media users view an issue or problem through sentiment analysis or classification activities. Lexicon-based algorithms and Support Vector Machine (SVM) are used with the CRISP-DM methodology for data mining. Therefore, this research aims to compare the performance of those two methodologies. The results of testing the model using 610 test data produce an accuracy level of sentiment analysis of Online Loans on social media Twitter using Lexicon-Based by 65% and SVM by 85%. The predicted results of the SVM method use 9,710 tweet data to produce 5,255 clean tweet data. 2,885 tweets are neutral, 1,190 data are positive tweets, 1,180 data are negative tweets, and 4,455 data are duplicates and empty tweets. With these results, it was found that the tendency of Indonesian people to use Twitter social media has views or opinions that are neutral towards online loans. The results of a comparison of the two methods based on performance metric calculations show that the SVM method has better performance when compared to the Lexicon-based method, with the highest precision value in the linear kernel SVM method for the positive class of 92%.

articleTitle: Design Approach for Child-Friendly Space in Densely Populated Settlements based on Behaviour Settings and Bing AI Image Generator. (Study Case: Kampung Wisata Jodipan (KWJ) Malang)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Along with the increasing population density and dense multi-story buildings around Kampung Wisata Jodipan (KWJ) Malang, it has an impact on the group of villagers who are still children. With so many dense buildings, there is limited space for children to interact or play. This results in a reduced area for social interaction and interaction with the surrounding natural environment. The purpose of this research is to create a design basis or design recommendation for a child-friendly play and interaction area. This research was conducted through several methods such as interviews, behavioural observation through a behavioural setting approach, and Bing Creator Image feature in the form of inputting several word interventions based on predetermined parameters. The results obtained from this research were to produce several new images (based on predetermined parameters) to be used as the basis for the design of the Bing Image Creator feature. The instructions used in the feature are based on physical, cognition, perception, emotion, and social parameters according to the conditions in KWJ Malang.

articleTitle: Case Study of 360 Image Viewer Software Utilization in Interior Design Presentation to Improve Product Immersion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This case study investigates the use of 360 Image Viewer software to improve product immersion in interior design presentations. The goal is to determine how the utilization of 360-degree photography technology may enhance the immersive experience and user engagement with items for interior design. This study uses a qualitative method to analyze observation. During design presentations, 360 Image Viewer software was evaluated by a sample of interior design experts and prospective clients. Users were able to move around in virtual environments thanks to the software, which gave them a sensation of presence and interaction. Observation was used to gather qualitative data with an emphasis on the participants’ impressions of immersion and participation. According to the investigation, using 360 Image Viewer software greatly improved product immersion and gave users a realistic and dynamic portrayal of the interior design. Participants noted a stronger understanding of the design concept and an improved sense of spatial presence. This case study illustrates the advantages of using 360 Image Viewer software and adds to the increasing body of information on immersive technology in interior design. The results show how such technology can improve the display and communication of products used in interior design, leading to greater client knowledge and involvement. In conclusion, this study promotes the use of 360- degree imaging as a technique to enhance product immersion and the quality of the entire interior design experience.

articleTitle: Hate Speech Detection in Indonesian Song Lyric Using BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study was conducted with the aim of detecting hate speech in song lyrics. The background of this study stems from the numerous negative impacts caused by hate speech. We focus on detecting hate speech in song lyrics because music is a popular form of art that can have significant impacts on people’s lives. There have been many previous studies that attempted hate speech detection using various methods. However, one issue still persists, especially when dealing with slang or uncommon sentence structures. According to the previous works, deep learning algorithms, such as using pre-trained BERT model for sentiment analysis and R-CNN as a classifier, have shown promise in addressing these issues. Hence, we decided to utilize the BERT pre-trained model for sentiment analysis and R-CNN as the classifier in their study. The dataset used in this research was collected from the Twitter dataset on Kaggle and also utilized the Spotify API. The study resulted in an precision score of 100% a recall score of 37% and an F1-score of 54% for the hate speech detection. Our result suggests that more relevant data, such as datasets consisting of poetry or sentences with implicit meanings, will be beneficial to enhance hate speech detection in song lyrics.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis With N-Gram Preprocessing for Online-Shopping Reviews in Indonesian Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Currently, online Shopping platforms have grown significantly, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic. This condition motivates the need for analyzing how the users/customers’ opinions on using such platform. Sentiment analysis, as a process of detecting, extracting, and classifying users’ opinions and attitudes toward specific topics, is a good tool for the required analysis. This study aims to evaluate the performance of machine learning approach which combined with N-Gram technique in doing sentiment analysis. The dataset used in this study comes from scraping reviews in Bahasa Indonesia regarding the Shopee Apps. In this study, $\mathrm{N}=2$ for the N-Gram was employed in the preprocessing process. Our main goal is to investigate whether the performance of machine learning in doing sentiment analysis can be improved by adding the N-Gram technique in its preprocessing. This work applied the Naive Bayes Classifier and k-Nearest Neighbor with $K=11$ as the machine learning algorithms. The best accuracy in this study was achieved by Naive Bayes Classifier after applying N-Gram Terms $(N=2)$ with Split Validation (8:2), which is $\mathbf{97.26\%}$.

articleTitle: Predictors of Perceived Customer Experience and Perceived Trust: Purchase Legal Woods Online on Web-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of e-service quality and information quality on online customer experience and perceived trust in online legal timber. The population in this study were consumers who had purchased legal wood on web-commerce with a total sample of 156 people and were selected using an accidental sampling technique. Empirical data was obtained from a questionnaire distributed to consumers who use web commerce and have purchased legal wood online. The data analysis method uses component-based structural equation modelling. The findings of this study indicate that e-service quality and information quality do not influence online customer experience perceptions. However, we found that e-service quality positively and significantly impacts customers’ perceived trust. Furthermore, information quality has a positive and significant effect on perceived trust, while online customer experience does not affect perceived trust. Therefore, the results of this research can be helpful in legal wood companies that sell online to find out the factors that significantly impact customer trust in web commerce.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Charger Dock for Electric Scooters Using Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The increasing demand of power and energy, energy conservation and use of renewable resources have become a crucial necessity. Solar energy will become the ultimate and prime source of energy in near future. Therefore, highly efficient and low energy consuming solar-powered equipment and applications will soon be a major requirement. In this paper, solar charge controller using Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) and Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) have been analyzed and compared, which is needed in all solar powered systems that utilize batteries. A major challenge in photovoltaic (PV) systems is Partial Shading which affects the quality and quantity of the Output Power. The natural variability of environment and the reduced efficiency of PV arrays is a significant obstacle in the rapid growth of the solar power systems. This system constantly monitors the solar panel and transmits the Output of PV, Battery, and Charging Scooter to IoT system over the internet with ESP8266. The Data Transmission using TX RX Protocol between Arduino Nano and ESP8266 for sending to web. The monitoring system implemented by MPPT for PV can operate and can be accessed via the website with a monitoring system accuracy of 99% with data collection in real time.

articleTitle: Privacy Engineering for Protection of Personal Identifiable Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The usage of data driven systems requires a serious concern on how users’ data privacy or specifically their Personal Identifiable Information (PII) are being handled. Privacy Engineering (PE) discipline needs to be cultivated among Computing students and software developers. Presently, data privacy discussion in Security courses and Software houses emphasis the enforcement of complying to data privacy legal acts. The technological aspects represented by PE, among others involve Privacy by Design (PbD) and Privacy Control Assessment tools are seldom taught. Thus, there is a gap between Privacy Engineering and Software Engineering, particularly in Malaysia. This work aims to give initial exposure to undergraduate students’ understanding and implementing privacy engineering in software development. A prototype of a mobile application is developed to demonstrate basic implementation of deidentification as part of PE, for an application that holds users’ PII.

articleTitle: Analysis of K-popers Sentiment of Indonesian Entertainment World with Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The “Korean Wave“ occurred in the world’s entertainment industry, including Indonesia. Korea is a trendsetter in the development of fashion and lifestyle today. The influence of Korean drama, Korean music (K-Pop), and Korean culture attracts the public’s attention, especially teenagers, causing imitation. However, during the “Korean Wave,“ Indonesian culture through its entertainment industry should be maintained. This study aims to determine Korean entertainment fans’ sentiments, often called K-Poppers, towards Indonesia’s entertainment world through sentiment analysis technology. This sentiment analysis can reveal how far K-Pop has opinions regarding the entertainment industry in their own country. This study uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm with Word2Vec as the word embedding process. The best model accuracy was obtained at 85% based on the learning experiments’ results. The results of the sentiment analysis show that 82.6% of K-Poppers have positive sentiments towards the entertainment industry in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) by Incorporating Machine Learning for Cyber Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Network security is a crucial component of Information Technology, yet organizations continue to grapple with meeting established security benchmarks. Given the rise in cyber-attacks and the continuous emergence of new attack types, it’s practically infeasible to persistently update attack patterns or signatures within security parameters. Key tools such as Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) are instrumental in monitoring network traffic and identifying potential threats. However, these tools face limitations, such as the high volume of alerts produced by IDS and the use of rule-based method, also the inability of SIEM tools to analyze logs comprehensively to identify inappropriate activities. This research has conducted anomaly detection using machine learning process to classify cyber-attacks network flow collected from IDS that installed incident network infrastructure. The analysis of IDS using machine learning, integrated with SIEM. The algorithm used in this research was Random Forest Classifier using CSE-CID-IDS2018 dataset pre-processed with Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Results of the experiments show that Random Forest Classifier Model, when combined with Principal Component Analysis (PCA), yields the most commendable results when applied to a 70/30 training/testing data ratio with accuracy of 0.99953.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review on IT Strategic Workspaces: Approach to Develop an Ideal Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Technology and information will always develop dynamically; this statement demands programmers to always be creative and keep up with the times. Despite this, their work ethic is always the same and tends to stagnate. Programmers’ perspectives on their workplace: this perspective is rarely seen as important and the opportunity for a comprehensive study is still widely open. This study aims to conduct a systematic literacy study to ascertain that the workplace has a crucial relationship with a programmer’s performance. The focus of the study includes a discussion of how programmers relate to their workplace in a tech company, benchmarking between various office layouts, and criteria that can be derived from the literature review regarding a degree of whether such a workplace is good or bad. The proper base facts are obtained. Nevertheless, the two entities are proven to be interrelated to each other. Such correlations are derived into tangible metrics and parameters (e.g., human cognitive, cultural, physical, behavioral, etc.). Relating issues regarding these topics are also presented.

articleTitle: Using IoT-Based Mobile Application to Build Smart Parking System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The idea of using the current technologies to build more sustainable smart cities has gained great popularity. One of attractive fields is Internet of Things applications to control vehicle traffic and parking which reduce energy consumption in smart cities. This paper presents an android mobile application system that allows users to check the availability and location of parking spots by using their smartphones. Main tools used for this project are the Arduino UNO and mobile application running with Android. Sensors were used to sense if the spot is empty, and then send that info to the mobile application. As the empty place is discovered to be vacant it is distinguished utilizing ultrasonic sensors which report it further. The system would not help the user to book parking spot but would show the availability of parking spot to reduce the searching time. This Smart Parking System is a basic prototype which can be improved later for real system by connecting the system to a GPS-based application which will direct the user to the spot itself and it can further be improved by using artificial intelligence to highlight different spots to different users.

articleTitle: Predicting Customer Trust and Behavioral Intention to Invest Cryptocurrency
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Cryptocurrency continues to be accepted globally, but many individuals (investors) still hesitate to use it (invest). Therefore, this study examines the predictive model of investors’ behavioral intentions to invest in Cryptocurrency by considering the following factors: experience, trust, social influence, and attitudes. Questionnaires were distributed online to the Cryptocurrency community in DKI Jakarta. Questionnaire data were analyzed using multivariate statistics: structural equation modeling based on variance (PLS-SEM). The study’s results prove that attitude, perceived trust, and social influence positively and significantly affect behavioral intention. Furthermore, social influence and perceived experience positively and significantly affect perceived trust. Finally, perceived trust has a positive and significant effect on attitude. This finding contributes to investment behavior by examining the determinants of adopting blockchain technology in the form of Cryptocurrency.

articleTitle: Market Basket Analysis on Telecommunications Prepaid Packages using the Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Data package purchase transactions with telecommunications operators are one of the company’s revenue generators. Purchasing operator packages can be done either through applications, e-commerce or distributors and outlets, where customers get a lot of exposure to telecommunications package offers. Telecommunications operators have the problem of how to be able to provide more appropriate offers to customers by determining which products are suitable to be offered on their channels. The purpose of this research is to analyze the purchase transaction data of operator data packages and use data mining to find patterns of package purchases that can be used to increase purchase transactions. This research is limited to processing transaction data and modeling with the results of the modeling algorithm which will be limited to product recommendations that are suitable for customers by taking the product package variations offered. The data mining method used uses Market Basket Analysis with the Apriori algorithm which produces predictions of package combinations that will be purchased by customers by utilizing a sample customer purchase transaction history data in March 2023. The model produces 19 product combinations to be offered to customers with the main product being a data package small quota of 500 MegaBytes combined with telephone package. The Main Combination that is formed shows customer behavior consisting of: a combination of small quota data packages with large quota telephone packages, combination of large quota data packages with small quota telephone packages, and digital packages combined with small quota data packages. Evaluation is carried out using support parameter limits >= 1%, confidence value >= 1% and lift ratio >= 1 of the achievement of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Wireless Resilience: A LoRa-Based Sensor Network and Mobile Application for Flood Victim Rescue System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This project aims to help flash floods’ victims and rescuers facilitate rescue efforts. By integrating Internet of Things (loT) and Global Positioning System (GPS) capabilities, flood victims can use a device (emergency box) that will be activated to send a signal to rescue workers and volunteers to come to the location and rescue them. The box is long lasting, can withstand winds and floats and has a bright light which allows rescuers to locate the victims even in dark or areas with no electricity. Rescuers use a device attached to a signal receiver that receives distress signals from flood victim’s emergency boxes. Then the navigation system will allow rescuers to locate the distress signals. This project has the potential to help rescuers and civilians alike, as this opens new ways to rescue people trapped in flooding by allowing different parties to join the rescue mission easily. The system was evaluated by the success of the rescuer’s device and the mobile application to send and receive respectively the distress signal from the flood’s victim device with accurate location coordinates in different weather conditions, indoor and outdoor, and in both open areas and between buildings. This will be done by taking measures of the power needed for both devices, the covering range between both devices, and the accuracy of the location coordinates.

articleTitle: A Study on Behavioral Intention to Use in Cryptocurrency Applications among Generation Z using UTAUT Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The study aims to examine the factors influencing the behavioral intention to use applications among Generation Z using the UTAUT Model. UTAUT model analyzes consumers’ adoption or usage of technology. A quantitative methodology has been adopted. A survey was conducted by distributing a questionnaire to 184 respondents. The data collected was analyzed using SEM-PUS. The findings show that the Behavioral Intention to use cryptocurrency applications among Gen Z is positively and significantly influenced by Trust, Performance Expectancy, Social Influence, and Facilitating Conditions. While the other variable namely Perceived Security and Behavioral Intention failed to show significant results.

articleTitle: Decentralized Identity (DID) for Know Your Customer (KYC) Process in the Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: KYC is vital for financial institutions worldwide to prevent illicit activities. The current process is slow, ineffective, and reliant on centralized databases. This study explores decentralized identification (DID) as a solution. DID enables efficient access to verified user credentials while enhancing user privacy. Thus, enhancing the speed and efficiency of the overall KYC process. The study employs the Design Science Research approach to systematically design the decentralized identity solution for KYC. Our solution employs blockchain and cryptographic technologies to enhance the DID process. Credentials submitted in the DID system are verified by a DID resolver, then stored and managed by an identity hub through the employment of a blockchain-based KYC contract. Ethereum JSON-RPC is employed to facilitate the DID authentication process. We also implemented zero-knowledge proofs to enhance users’ privacy. The result of this study contributes to the advancement of KYC by offering practical insights, design guidelines, and evaluation measures for the implementation of decentralized identification.

articleTitle: Electronic Service Quality and Information Quality on Online Customer Satisfaction: A Study of Legal Woods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This analysis aims to determine the influence of information quality, electronic service quality, online customer satisfaction and usefulness on online green legal wood purchasing behaviour. The descriptive quantitative method was used in this research. We have utilised SmartPLS 3.0 software. Accidental sampling with 156 respondents was used in this research. Data were obtained with the results of questionnaires with consumers using web-commerce tokoperhutani.com. This research found that e-service quality significantly and positively impacts usefulness. The quality of e-service also significantly and positively affects online customer satisfaction. We found a positive and significant impact on usefulness with the information quality variable. Information quality positively and significantly impacts online customer satisfaction usefulness impacts online customer satisfaction. The input from the results of this research can be helpful for the management of tokoperhutani.com to find out what factors significantly impact customer satisfaction on the tokoperhutani.com web-commerce.

articleTitle: Behavioral Intention to Use Mobile Banking using UTAUT 2 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Today’s non-cash transaction solution is mobile banking, which is quick and to the point. only possible with a smartphone. Nowadays, nearly everyone owns a smartphone. But not all of them favor using mobile banking for their transactions. This is what sparked our interest in gathering data on the variables affecting consumers of mobile banking. The purpose of this study was to identify the variables that may affect bank customers’ behavioral intentions when utilizing the mobile banking application to complete routine banking operations using the UTAUT 2 Model Approach. This study collected 200 samples from DKI Jakarta-based users of mobile banking applications utilizing a quantitative research method and the probability sampling methodology called convenience sampling. SmartPLS 4 software was used to process the data once it had been obtained and subjected to SEM-PLS analysis. The hedonic motivation, habit, and price value variables each had favorable and significant effect on behavioral intention of mobile banking users, according to the analysis and processing of the data results. In the meanwhile, expectations for performance, effort, social impact, and facilitation each had no significance effect on behavioral intention

articleTitle: Examining the impact of attitude, availability, price, and quality of service on broadband Internet customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: After the COVID-19 pandemic, broadband internet utilization is predicted to continue to grow and experience a significant increase. The pandemic has changed how people work, study, communicate, shop, and carry out many aspects of daily life. Research reported that since 2018, research on broadband internet has continued to increase until now. This quantitative study examines the impact of the four critical variables on the link between attitude, availability, pricing, and quality of service (QoS) on broadband internet customer satisfaction using the Structural Equation Model approach and the Partial Lease Square technique. Three hundred and sixty-one citizen respondents in DKI Jakarta Province were collected using the snowball sampling method facilitated by Google Forms. At the same time, the COVID-19 post-pandemic was still ongoing in Indonesia. Through rigorous statistical analysis, the results show that customer satisfaction with broadband internet services is influenced by all factors, from attitude towards broadband Internet, broadband Internet availability, broadband Internet price, and service quality. The implications of this research are significant for service providers. They provide actionable insights for developing effective strategies to improve customer satisfaction and increase broadband internet subscriptions.

articleTitle: Digital Bank Security in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to review and analyze the trust and security aspects of digital banking with the aim of obtaining valid and comprehensive information about the security views of users of digital banking services. Due to cyber security threats, users often use traditional methods instead of technology to think about security. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to investigate the intensity and trust of digital banking behavior completed by 434 respondents online using a Google form. The obtained data were then analyzed using CB-SEM (Structural Equation Modeling Based on Covariance) SmartPLS 4 application. The results showed that investor expectations, habits, security and social influence influence the adoption or use of digital banking services, while enabling conditions, hedonic motivation and work expectations do not influence the use of digital banking based on the feedback of existing users. Digital banking services. This study shows that the higher the investment of users, the more often they use digital banking services, habits, high security and social factors that encourage users to continue using digital banking services. However, the terms of service and performance expectations do not affect users’ use of digital banking services. Through this study, readers will gain new knowledge and awareness of the factors that influence the use of digital banking services and increase users’ confidence in the security of digital banking in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Customer’s Intention to Continue Using Mobile Banking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Mobile banking is a new development that everyone should embrace to make the banking system more convenient and easy. Therefore, this study examines the factors influencing users’ intention to continue using mobile banking. The study employed a quantitative method involving primary data collection through a survey. The questionnaire was distributed using the purposive sampling technique, SPSS was used to describe the respondent’s profile, and SmartPLS was used for convergent validity, discriminant validity and hypothesis testing. The findings indicate that satisfaction significantly impacts the intention to continue using mobile banking applications. Additionally, as expected, perceived risk affects relationship quality and customer satisfaction. Relationship quality has no impact on continuance intention, and service quality has no impact on perceived risk. The results emphasize the importance of mobile banking application developers actively informing users about the value of relationships and satisfaction to encourage continued intention to use mobile banking applications in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Determinant Factors of Continuance Intention to Use MOOCs: An Empirical Evidence from Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study has the objective of investigating the determinant factors that impact the intention of users to continue using Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs). To achieve this objective, the study employs two widely used models, namely the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Task-Technology Fit (TTF) models, to examine technology acceptance and utilization. The significance of this study lies in its ability to provide empirical evidence regarding the factors that are likely to influence users’ intention to continue using MOOCs. The study involved a sample of 294 participants from Indonesia who have already utilized MOOCs. The findings of the study demonstrate that the integration of the TTF model for utility and TAM for technology acceptance offers a more comprehensive understanding of users’ behavior in the context of this study. Specifically, the attitude (ATT) variable is found to be the most significant factor influencing the intention to continue using MOOCs. Surprisingly, the variables of Perceived Ease of Use and Perceived Usefulness do not have a significant impact on users’ intention to continue using MOOCs. The TTF and Social Motivation variables, on the other hand, do have an influence on Perceived Usefulness, while the feature of MOOCs has an impact on Perceived Ease of Use. These findings have both theoretical and practical implications for researchers, developers, and practitioners in the field of MOOCs.

articleTitle: New Product Launching and Hedonism: Augmented Reality as A Moderator of Impulsive Buying Behavior on Motor Show Events
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the effects of new product launching, hedonism, and Augmented Reality as a moderator on visitor intention at Motor Show Events. Online survey was used to collect data. Data were analysed using Partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM) techniques. The result shows that new product launching, and hedonism significantly and positively affect visitor intention. Furthermore, augmented Reality also significantly moderates between new product launching and intention to visit, as well as hedonism and intention to visit.

articleTitle: Applying E-Payment for Improving MSME’s Revenue in Jabodetabek: An Extended TAM Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The objective of this research is to explore the variables that influence the usage of E-Payment in Jabodetabek region’s MSMEs as well as how it may influence the revenue of the business, using the Extended Technology Acceptance Model. The quantitative method is use to collect data and information, where primary data will be obtained through Online Questioners and interviews with MSMEs owners and employees-in-charge, 188 responses were processed using Smart PLS 4. The findings show that applying E-Payment in MSMEs has a positive and significant impact towards increasing their revenue. However, many respondents reported problems regarding a delay for their revenue reimbursement and some connectivity issues. Thus, not only making it hard to manage their cash flow, but also made some MSMEs not interested in continuing to use E-Payment. This study gave insights to EPayment vendors to improve their platforms so more MSMEs will apply this payment method for their business and help the Indonesian government to fulfill their digital transformation for transactions in the country.

articleTitle: Changes Analysis in Public Opinion Regarding Binary Option Trends using K-Means++
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Binary option-based applications are being discussed in Indonesia because several influencers are promoting the application. But the government said the app is included in gambling, which makes the app illegal. Some influencers have become associated with binary options cases, which have made people busy giving opinions about binary options on social media. This study aims to analyze the changes in public opinion regarding binary options in Indonesia. This research use K-Means++ algorithm to construct the opinion clusters. The data used in this study was taken from Twitter social media from January 1,2022, to March 31,2022, with total 19,669 data that divided into two moments, between before and after the case of binary options in Indonesia. Based on result of Elbow method, there are 4 and 6 optimum cluster that can be analyzed. Clustering with the K-Means++ algorithm gets good results with an average of silhouette coefficient value of 0.6605. The opinion analysis result show that before the case of the arrest of binary option application affiliates in Indonesia, people tended to express neutral opinions. However, after the case was widely discussed and confirmed as fraudulent investment scams, Indonesian people still expressed opinions in neutral language but agreed that binary options applications are not trading and illegal under Indonesian law.

articleTitle: Social Media User Characteristics Nowadays and its Effects on AirAsia Brand Awareness and Brand Image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Specifically focused on the social media users of AirAsia, the goal of this study is to ascertain the impacts of social media usage characteristics on e-WOM, trust, brand awareness, and brand image in the airline business. The substantial impact of social media interaction on e-WOM and consumer confidence in social media marketing for airlines led to the conduct of this study. Quantitative analysis will be used in the study technique, and questionnaires and interviews will be used to collect data. SEM analysis was used to create and test these hypotheses. The result of this study is to assist the company in identifying which characteristics have an impact on WOM. Personality characteristics and social characteristics have no valuable effect on e-WOM related to the influence of social media usage. Information characteristics have a significant influence on e-WOM related to the influence of social media usage. E-WOM has an influence on trust related to the influence of the use of social media. E-WOM has an effect on brand awareness related to the influence of the use of social media. E-WOM influences brand image related to the influence of the use of social media. Trust has an effect on brand awareness related to the effect of the use of social media. Trust influences brand image related to the influence of the utilization of social media. The conclusions drawn from this research will serve as valuable insights for the company, enabling it to develop effective marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness and brand image.

articleTitle: Small Town Settlement Virtual Reality (VR) Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This project focuses on the development of a video game called Small Town Settlement, a city-building game genre for building and managing a self-sustaining settlement for the benefit of society in an entertaining way.
