This project utilizes the VR technology to create an immersive experience for the players which includes the user interaction and control scheme in the VR, core gameplay mechanics, storyline, character design and level design. The game is developed using Unity on a Windows PC platform. An initial playtesting was conducted on the interaction with objects, interaction with the map, walking around the map, interaction with NPC, interaction with the user interface and menus, and the tutorial of the game; and the feedback received was used to improve one of the features of the game.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on the Pros and Cons of Cryptocurrencies using the Multinomial Naïve Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Public awareness of the existence of cryptocurrencies in Indonesia is increasing. However, there are not a few people who reject cryptocurrencies, there are still many Indonesian people who refuse for various reasons, one of which is because the very high price fluctuations of this currency make investing in cryptocurrencies an investment with high risk. Therefore, this research aims to find out public opinion on cryptocurrencies through the comments of Twitter social media, including positive or negative sentiments. This research classifies tweets with positive and negative opinions on cryptocurrencies using the Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB) method. The research experiment results show good performance with an accuracy of 79%, a precision of 78% and a recall of 85%. Then, the in-depth sentiment analysis results indicate that most Indonesian people have more positive sentiment (71.7%) on cryptocurrencies issues than negative sentiment (28.3%).

articleTitle: Understanding Antecedents Subscription Intentions for Video Streaming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to see the effect of Involvement, Moral Judgment, Perceived Risk and Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) application on customer intention to use a paid version of the video streaming service. This study uses a survey model using a quantitative research approach with data instruments using a questionnaire. A total of 113 responses are collected in this study. Questionnaire data that has been collected is analyzed by Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) using SmartPLS 3.0 tools. The results of the analysis show that the TPB application (attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavior control) can explain the factors that influence a person’s intention to enter subscription intentions of video streaming services. Apart from these three variables, it was also found that the intention was subscribed to by involvement, moral judgment, and perceived risk.

articleTitle: Investigating Perceived Digital Switching Cost and Customer Satisfaction-Loyalty Model on Video on Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Recently, the number of video-on-demand (VOD) subscribers increased as subscribers enjoyed watching various content during COVID-19. VOD platforms give captivating, inspiring, and commercial-free binge-watching experiences. As 75% of VOD growth was contributed by Indonesia and Thailand, VOD’s marketing practices and programming decisions using network brand identity approaches in Indonesia. Therefore, the competition of network provider companies is becoming more competitive. After examining VOD’s approach to network provider companies, this study considers the brand loyalty of VOD’s subscribers to Indonesian network providers. We use an online poll (survey) with 117 respondents to determine the factors influencing brand loyalty, customer satisfaction, perceived digital value, and perceived digital switching cost. The Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Square (SEM-PLS) approach and the Bootstrap parameter estimation method are utilized to ascertain the link between these latent variables. The study’s findings indicate that perceived digital value and perceived digital switching significantly affect brand loyalty. Based on the findings, we suggest implications to improve and maintain the value and price of the services.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis of The Attendance Module in E-Kemenkeu Application Using Design Thinking Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The Attendance Module, a part of the e-Kemenkeu application developed by Pusintek, has been used by Ministry of Finance employees since 2020 to facilitate attendance recording during the Covid-19 pandemic. User satisfaction was evaluated through an online questionnaire and interviews conducted from November 15 to December 12,2021, with a total of 10,580 respondents. The user satisfaction index was reported as 4.32 out of 5, while the user’s expectation index was 4.68 out of 5. These results indicate the need for improvements in the e-Kemenkeu application, including its interface design. Based on the survey findings, reengineering and rebranding efforts were undertaken to transform the e-Kemenkeu application into the Satu Kemenkeu application. This study utilized a design thinking method with a human-centered approach, involving employees of the Ministry of Finance. The design thinking process, which includes empathizing, defining, ideating, prototyping, and testing, was used to generate creative ideas based on user experiences and identified problems with the Attendance Module. The outcome of this research is a prototype of the Attendance Module interface design, which was tested and received positive feedback from 92% of the 5,000 respondents who participated in the questionnaire. This indicates that the prototype design successfully addressed user needs.

articleTitle: Systematic Review: Image Processing Based Dorsal Vein Pattern Biometric Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Biometrics leverages unique biological or behavioral traits for person or object identification, characterized by traits such as uniqueness, indivisibility, immutability, and resilience against loss or theft. Evolving biometric systems include facial recognition, iris scanning, fingerprint recognition, palm line recognition, and dorsal hand vein recognition. Dorsal hand vein identification, concealed beneath the skin, provides a highly secure biometric modality resistant to forgery, tampering, or damage. This systematic literature review offers an overview of dorsal hand vein image processing for biometric authentication systems, covering recent advancements in image processing, including concept clarification, data acquisition, pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and identification phases. The review spans research articles from 2018 to 2023, sourced from reputable outlets such as 208 MDPI journals, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, Google Books, and other scholarly repositories. Stringent article selection, guided by predefined keywords, ensures research quality. Findings emphasize the necessity of a camera and infrared LED for dorsal hand vein data acquisition to build an effective identification system. Pre-processing involves Region of Interest (ROI) selection, contrast enhancement, and intensity normalization. Segmentation employs morphological operations, filter banks, and adaptive thresholding. Feature extraction encompasses statistical features and the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM). Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) play a pivotal role in identification, featuring layers such as Conv1_1, Conv1_2, batch normalization, max-pooling, and dropout layers.

articleTitle: An Investigation into Student Performance Prediction using Regularized Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The problem of university dropout poses a significant challenge to education systems worldwide, affecting administrators, teachers, and students. Early identification and intervention strategies are crucial for addressing this issue. In addition, advances in machine learning have paved the way for more accurate predictions of student performance. This paper investigates the use of regularization techniques, specifically Lasso (L1) and Ridge (L2) regularization, within logistic regression models to improve the accuracy of performance prediction. This research’s dataset was obtained from the Binus Online Learning platform at Bina Nusantara University, with a focus on the Information System study program between 2020 and 2021. The results reveal that logistic regression with regularization achieves a high level of accuracy, recall, and precision in predicting student performance. The findings contribute to the development of an early warning system to identify at-risk students, enabling timely intervention and support.

articleTitle: Utilizing Different Edge Detection and Preprocessing Techniques to Improve the Accuracy of Durian Cultivar Detection using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Using machine learning to recognize images of fruits or plants is a very practical and focused application. When using machine learning principles to classify specific fruit varieties, as opposed to traditional approaches, a higher level of accuracy is promised but also requiring more training data. Particularly in situations where different cultivars of the same fruit family are valued differently, the capacity to recognize and classify diverse cultivars of a fruit family is crucial. The objective of this study is to develop a practical method for classifying the many cultivars of Durio zibethinus, also known as Durian, based on the visual traits of the crop using Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs) to improve the accuracy and speed of cultivar recognition. Utilizing a database of images with tagged Durian cultivars. Images from two high-value classes of Durian cultivars are utilized to train the neural network. The first phases in the research project involve pre-processing and converting the images using Canny, Laplacian, Sobel on X-axis, and image binarization. Next up are model training, model validation, and network architecture development. Finally, they were combined as an ensemble machine learning method using majority voting to examine the potential for enhancing prediction performance. Laplacian edge detection was found to yield the best results of the four studied approaches, while ensemble methods gave more accurate results than a single method.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of the difference between conventional and precast WWTP septic tank costs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Every human-occupied building generates fecal waste that must be effectively managed to prevent environmental pollution. One method of processing this waste is through the use of Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTP) in the form of septic tanks, either communal or conventional. The communal septic tank concept involves several homes connected to a single unit, whereas the conventional septic tank operates as an individual WWTP. Conventional septic tanks can be constructed using bricks and concrete with specifically designed technical specifications. This study aims to compare the costs between conventional and precast septic tanks using an experimental analysis method. Additionally, this research aims to provide insights for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) considering venturing into the production of precast septic tanks. The method employed in this study is experimental analysis, where the cost data for both conventional and precast septic tanks will be collected and analyzed. The outcomes of this study are anticipated to benefit communities seeking more affordable WWTP construction options. Moreover, this research is expected to open new business opportunities for MSMEs in the production of precast septic tanks.

articleTitle: Moderator Model of Entertainment-Augmented Reality to Predict Visitor Intention: Findings from Indonesian Motor Show Events
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This article aims to predict the impact of entertainment and augmented reality (AR) on visitor intention to visit Indonesia Motor Show event. An online questionnaire was used to gather data. Partly least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) approaches were used to examine data. The results demonstrate that the attraction of sales promotion girls significantly and positively impacts visitor intention. A significant and positive association between entertainment and intention to visit was also discovered. Augmented reality also significantly moderates sales promotion girls and visit intention, as well as significantly moderates entertainment and visit intention. As AR has a moderating impact on the visitor’s intention, the company as an organizer should optimize the use of AR to enhance visitor intention to attend the Indonesia Motor Show exhibition, to make visitors desire to return to the next year’s exhibition.

articleTitle: Analysis of the design prototype for prefabricated building components in subsidized housing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The rapid population growth and urbanization in Indonesia have escalated the demand for affordable and habitable housing. Subsidized housing development has been posited as a solution to this burgeoning need. However, conventional construction methods grapple with challenges such as limited land availability, elevated costs, extended durations, subpar building quality, adverse environmental impacts, and associated social issues. Consequently, this research aims to design prefabricated building component modules for subsidized housing as an alternative construction methodology that is swift, environmentally friendly, and reduces construction waste. The adopted method was experimental, focusing on the design of building component modules, which were subsequently simulated using a computer aided design (CAD) application. This study endeavors to elucidate the requirements for affordable and habitable housing in Indonesia. It has produced prefabricated building component modules for subsidized housing as a reference for application. The anticipated outcomes of this research are expected to significantly contribute to the evolution of a more rapid, eco friendly subsidized housing construction methodology that minimizes construction waste. This would pave the way for more efficient and effective subsidized housing development, catering to societal housing needs without compromising environmental integrity during construction.

articleTitle: Predicting Anger Proneness Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)

authors.preferredName: Ida Bagus Gede Purwa Manik Adiputra

abstract: High levels of anger proneness can affect the individuals and others around them in the society. Anger proneness or the likelihood of experiencing anger in response to certain stimuli or situations is influenced by a variety of factors, including personality traits, life experiences, and environmental factors. Accurately predicting the level of anger proneness in individuals can help mitigate a variety of risks, including relationship and mental health problems. In this paper, we tried to create a model that is capable of accurately predicting levels of anger proneness based on one’s answers to a personality questionnaire. To do so, we utilized a deep learning algorithm namely SAINT (Self-Attention and Intersample Attention Transformer), alongside with other three machine learning and deep learning algorithms as the comparisons, LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), and XGBoost (EXtreme Gradient Boosting). The four models were trained with the same dataset and the same data preprocessing methods. All the four algorithms couldn’t manage to produce any models with satisfactory performances, with the highest performing model produced using the state-of-the-art machine learning classifier XGBoost only achieving 55.38% accuracy. Multiple data preprocessing methods such as resampling and feature selection with the help of XGBoost were applied to the dataset with negligible effects to the models’ performances. The results lead us to the conclusion that the dataset contains too many inconsistencies in its rows, as can be fairly expected from a dataset based on individuals’ responses to an online personality questionnaire. The inconsistencies affected all the models’ ability to find the patterns in between rows and columns and compromise their resulting efficacies to do the inferences.

articleTitle: Factors that Influence E-Satisfaction and Their Impact on Online Purchase Intention of Telemedicine Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study embarked on a rigorous examination of the factors driving user satisfaction and usage behavior in the context of telehealth applications. Utilizing a well- structured Google Form survey, distributed through an array of social media platforms, including WhatsApp, Discord, Instagram, and Line, the research gathered 251 responses. The purposive sampling technique was employed to ensure that the data captured the experiences of individuals who had actively engaged with telehealth services. One hypothesis, relating to the influence of Online Reviews, was found to be unsupported. This surprising result suggests that, contrary to expectations, the opinions and reviews shared online do not significantly affect users’ satisfaction or their behavioral decisions in the context of telehealth applications. This finding highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of the factors influencing user preferences and choices in this rapidly evolving sector. Conversely, other hypotheses examining factors such as Social Influence, Facilitating Conditions, Perceived Reliability, Price Value, and Purchase Intention were substantiated. The positive influence of these factors on customer usage behavior underscores their significance in shaping user experiences and satisfaction within the telehealth ecosystem. Furthermore, the study posits that facilitating conditions should be closely aligned with technological advancements, as this alignment is conducive to the development of enhanced application features. This insight suggests that telehealth providers should continuously innovate and integrate advanced technologies to ensure that the facilitating conditions meet the ever-evolving needs and expectations of users.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Dinotis Application Web PT Davel Surya Cipta Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Dinotis is a platform for content creator and community that has been developed by PT Davel Surya Cipta to express and monetize content directly from audiences with real-time videos through direct payments by offering solutions for creator, communities and companies. The Dinotis application has been downloaded by more than 5,000 users on Playstore. However, there are several inconvenience experiences of user related to user registration, login, the application interface is less user-friendly and some bugs that has still appear. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to analyze the user experience of the Dinotis application in terms of the ease and convenience of accessing the application and to provide recommendations from the experience of the Dinotis application user. The analytical method uses a survey and usability testing. The survey was conducted using the USE Questionnaire method, where the product evaluation refers to four dimensions, namely usefulness, satisfaction, ease of use and ease of learning. From the results of usability testing of 20 selected respondents, for usefulness is 76%, satisfaction is 72%, ease of use is 77% and ease of learning is 81%. From the results of the analysis, the recommendations will provide for application improvements and Market Fit for the user interface, namely adding a shortcut to the top page and screen resolution according to the size of the monitor or laptop and minimizing the action to return to the main page.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Mobile-Based Payment Using Usability Testing and System Usability Scale Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The development of information technology is now growing rapidly. In fact, the internet is now one of the technologies that provide a very large role for all fields. One of the uses of information technology is the POPAY Application or Paperless Online Payment System, which offers convenience in processing payment application documents, both internal and external company payments. However, there are still some findings of complaints from POPAY mobile application users. These complaints were obtained by filling out questionnaires that have been distributed to POPAY mobile application users. Therefore, the analysis in this study aims to find out and compare the observations of POPAY mobile application users. Using usability testing methods and system usability scale as a combination of the methodology. From the results of user experience analysis, partial success was obtained 4 times and failure 2 times in the efficiency aspect. The percentage of memorability rate is 80% and is included in category C in the aspect of satisfaction with an average SUS score of 63,25. Improvements are needed in the application with recommendation solutions, such as information on account details, document attachment review features, application auto-login, and 4 types of search options on the ‘Tracking By’ feature.

articleTitle: Development of Diabetes Mellitus Diagnosis Method Based Random Forest Classifier with Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is a chronic metabolism that has symptom in a rise in blood sugar level. In terms of the total number of DM patients worldwide, Indonesia comes in at the seventh position out of 10 nations. DM is a disease that is very dangerous and causes various complications. To mitigate the effects and complications of DM, a diagnosis early on DM is necessary. The diagnosis of DM is generally carried out by an expert doctor who requires a high cost and the diagnosis result tends to be bias in between expert doctors. DM diagnosis method-based machine learning needs to be created to obtain a diagnostic method at an affordable cost. One of the known machine learning methods that can be used to develop DM diagnostic method is Random Forest (RF). It is relatively fast, simple, resistant to outliers and noise, easy to parallelize, avoids overfitting and is a good solution. However, the performance of the RF method is influenced by the selection of its hyperparameters. Appropriate selection of RF hyperparameters will improve the performance of all RF methods. RF hyperparameter selection can be solved by using global algorithm optimization. The Swarm Intelligence (SI) algorithm is one of the optimization methods for solving the optimization with many local optima points. It has many advantages, such as it is resilient, simple to use, does not require derivatives, and can identify a global optimal from multiple local optimums. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is one of SI method that is widely used and has advantages in the balance of exploration and exploitation. To solve this problem, this works proposes a diagnosis DM by using RF-based approach and PSO. From the experimental results, it can be concluded that the proposed method is superior to the conventional RF and for DM diagnosis. The smaller number of particles results the faster in computational time. The different number of particles results not different performance significantly. The experimental results also show that the DM Diagnosis Method Based on the RF with PSO can avoid overfitting condition.

articleTitle: Crude Oil Price Forecasting: A Comparative Analysis of ARIMA, GRU, and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Since 2020, the world hasn’t been able to recover fully from the economic crisis that is caused by the pandemic and the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine. Crude oil is one of the key ingredients that shapes the world’s economy as of today. This research paper is aimed to predict uncertainty and volatility of crude oil’s prices with time series approaches. To predict crude oil prices, we need to implement Machine Learning and Deep Learning models such as RNN models (LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, and Multi-LSTM) and ARIMA models. To improve the accuracy of the models, we need to preprocess certain data. Picking a variable to be processed is also necessary, in this case we used opening price and date to determine crude oil prices going forward. Data scaling is necessary to maintain numeric data and Ad fuller Test is a must to acknowledge data stationarity. After preprocessing and fitting the data into models, we can see that LSTM and ARIMA stood out within other models, LSTM has an RMSE score of 6.62 and MAE of 4.96 whilst ARIMA has an RMSE score of 6.5 and MAE of 5.03. All the models used are good in predicting crude oil prices, because the R2-Score is ideal, not overfitting and underfitting. This approach on predicting crude oil prices will certainly be impactful in the global economy and avoiding panic bull and bear markets of the crude oil price.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Diabetes Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease that influences how the human body turns food into energy and affects a significant portion of the global population. Diabetes prediction plays a major role in helping diagnose diabetes, which can help prevent complications and improve patient outcomes. This paper presents a machine learning approach for predicting the onset of diabetes using clinical and demographic data. The dataset used is from the Pima Indian Diabetes Database (PIDD), which was gathered from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. This dataset contains various variables such as pregnancies, glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, body mass index (BMI), diabetes pedigree function, and age. Some preprocessing methods, such as oversampling and removing zero values to impossible data, was done to the dataset in order to balance and improve the input data. Then the paper compares four different machine learning algorithms, which are the K-Nearest Neighbors Algorithm (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Random Forest (RF). These models are then built to be predictive. The model’s performance is assessed using a number of metrics, including the F1-score, accuracy, precision, and recall. The Random Forest algorithm works better than other models, according to the results by achieving an accuracy of 89.5%, a precision of 97%, a recall of 83%, and an f1-score of 89%. This study shows the potential of machine learning approaches in diabetes prediction as well as the efficacy of the suggested preprocessing strategy which hopefully help clinicians identify individuals at risk of developing diabetes for early intervention.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of User Experience (UX) for Human Resource Information System (HRIS) Time Management System (TMS) Module at PT Astra Daihatsu Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In large companies, management of human resources using a Human Resource Information System (HRIS) is of utmost importance. The HRIS serves as a system for collecting, storing, managing, analyzing, and presenting data to provide HRD needs. At PT ADM, the HRIS currently consists of various modules, such as employee data, performance management, people development, and time management systems (TMS). Among these modules, TMS stands out with its high transaction volume. However, HRD PT ADM frequently receives complaints about the confusing process associated with the TMS module. To address this issue, an analysis was conducted to evaluate the user experience within the TMS module of the HRIS. The objective was to identify usability issues and propose a prototype for website improvement, using the Design Thinking approach. To measure usability, the System Usability Scale was employed, and questionnaires were distributed to gather feedback. Out of the total population, 49 respondents participated (>10% response rate). The questionnaire’s results yielded an overall rating of 66.7, indicating poor usability. The identified issues on the HRIS website mainly revolved around inconsistent language terms, excessive sidebar menus, unnecessary menu items, filter problems, and SAP integration challenges. Based on these findings, a prototype for the HRIS was developed, and user feedback was collected. The feedback received an average rating of 4.5 out of 5, signifying a significant improvement in the system usability. The new prototype has greatly facilitated the HRIS process, solving the previous difficulties faced by users.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Mobile Banking Applications with System Usability Scale and Usability Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Mobile banking has become a significant innovation in the modern banking sector. Banks have launched mobile banking apps to provide customers with easier and faster banking services. Despite the growing number of mobile banking users, previous research should have paid more attention to the analysis of user experience in the use of mobile banks. The study aims to analyze the user experience of mobile banking applications. The methodology is using qualitative methods with the System Usability Scale and quantitative methods with usability testing. The study results showed that the average value of the System Usability Scale indicates a low user satisfaction, indicating the need to improve the usability of mobile banking applications. Meanwhile, Average usability testing results give good results, but some tasks take a long time to complete the task. This collides with satisfaction aspects that get low values. Based on the findings, the study recommended improvements to improve the design of a more intuitive interface. The academic implication is giving contribution based on combinations of the methodology, as practical implication, banks can improve the user experience of mobile banking, strengthen the relationship with customers, and increase the adoption of the use of mobile banking services overall.

articleTitle: Dissecting Instagram’s Impact on Brand Image and Customer Behavior for Ramu Nostalgia Indonesia in an Era of Rapid Digital Marketing Evolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Digital marketing via social media in the food and beverage (F&B) sector is witnessing rapid growth, as seen with Ramu Nostalgia on Instagram. The goal of this research is to assess the impact of Instagram on the hedonic brand image and its subsequent effect on customer behavior at Ramu Nostalgia Indonesia. The study adopts a quantitative research methodology. Questionnaires were randomly distributed to 113 customers of Ramu Nostalgia Indonesia. A structural equation model (SEM) via the SmartPLS 3 software was used for analysis. The findings confirm a significant impact of social media on the hedonic brand image, which, in turn, greatly influences the customer behavior of Ramu Nostalgia Indonesia. It’s recommended for Ramu Nostalgia Indonesia to sustain its effective social media marketing approach and tailor its promotional strategies to its target audience. This study’s implications suggest that businesses should align their advertisements and promotions on social media with their target demographics to cultivate a favorable hedonic brand image and customer behavior. The established customer behavior can then motivate initial purchases, repeat transactions, and product recommendations to others.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Website Content as an Environmental Communication Media: Case Study of Bromotenggersemeru.org
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The research analyzes the efforts of Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park Authority in communicating environmental issues through the website bromotenggersemeru.org. They launched the official website bromotenggersemeru.org, through which information about conservation activities, biodiversity, and natural beauty can be conveyed to the broader community. They use the descriptive qualitative method by conducting text analysis of bromotenggersemeru.org news content. The data collected from the news will be interpreted using Fairclough’s Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA) approach. The website is an effective platform to spread knowledge about environmental awareness. Findings show that the website actively provides environmental-related news, education, and awareness content. However, communication effectiveness could be improved in the digital era, lagging behind social media, online news, and television in user preferences. Therefore, the research recommends leveraging social media as an effective communication tool due to its broad reach, interactivity, and appealing visual features. Utilizing social media, the National Park Authority can reach a larger audience, encourage interaction, and enhance the visual appeal of environmental messages. Monitoring trends and user preferences help tailor messages to the audience. The research provides practical recommendations for improving environmental communication strategies and strengthening conservation efforts.

articleTitle: Design of a digitalized recharge system for groundwater sustainability in water exploitation areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The transition of land use from open to closed areas has reduced infiltration spaces, causing a significant increase in surface rainwater runoff. Consequently, this has resulted in flooding during the rainy season and drought during the dry months, a phenomenon observed throughout Indonesia, especially in urban areas. Additionally, groundwater exploitation by drinking water companies, as witnessed in Sukabumi and other regions in Indonesia, is suspected to exacerbate the drought, causing widespread community concern over the past decades. Given these challenges, this research aims to develop a design for an infiltration well capable of harvesting rainwater and facilitating the seepage of household wastewater. This infiltration well water treatment design is equipped with sensors to detect the infiltration water discharge so that the infiltration water discharge can be known periodically. Based on measurements via sensors in infiltration wells, in each water exploitation area, the number of infiltration wells needed can be identified. It is hoped that this design can then be applied to the construction of housing complexes, as well as being the basis for stakeholders in determining the requirements for infiltration wells when changing open land to closed land.

articleTitle: Model of Blockchain Adoption in Financial Audit Profession
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the industrial era 4.0, the evolution of technology is very fast. One of them is the presence of blockchain technology. Auditors can use blockchain to track transaction history, confirm data validity, and ensure system integrity. Blockchain also allows auditors to securely store and transfer data between different parties, ensuring that data in motion will not be lost or compromised. However, the use of blockchain technology among auditors is still small. This is a research gap that we want to examine. We do research on factors affecting auditor adoption of blockchain. We use construct or variables from Innovation Diffusion Theory. Our research uses quantitative methods, data analysis uses structural equation modeling partial least squares. we collect primary data obtained from distributing questionnaires to auditors who work in public accounting firms in Jakarta. The results of our research state that the relative advantage, compatibility, trialability, observability of each has a significant influence on the auditor adoption of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of the quality of domestic wastewater before and after treatment using WWTP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Domestic waste, resulting from human daily activities, can pollute the environment if not properly managed. The necessity for human-occupied structures to have wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) to process this waste becomes evident. This study adopts an experimental approach, designing conventional WWTPs equipped with waste treatment procedures. Through sampling methods and laboratory analysis, this research aims to measure the quality of domestic waste before and after treatment. Results indicate a significant improvement in water quality following the treatment process, meeting the established water quality standards. These findings provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of domestic waste treatment and offer guidelines for communities to adopt better waste management practices, ensuring environmental protection.

articleTitle: MQTT-Enabled Smart Door Access System: Design and Implementation Using NodeMCU ESP 8266 and HiveMQ
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The security of one’s residence or property is an essential consideration that warrants careful attention to safeguard the premises and its contents. It has become increasingly apparent today that physical key door locks are susceptible to damage and can be compromised by unauthorized individuals. The inherent vulnerability of physical key door locks stems from their susceptibility to misplaced keys and duplication, as individuals are required to always carry them. This work presents a novel Internet of Things (IoT) enabled smart door access system designed to improve the security of homes or premises. The system offers keyless access to individuals who have been granted authorization. The system’s architectural design incorporates the utilization of a NodeMCU ESP 8266 microcontroller to oversee door operations. Access control functionality is facilitated through the implementation of the Virtuino IoT application, which enables the unlocking of doors using smartphones. Additionally, a MQTT broker, specifically the HiveMQ, is implemented to facilitate effective machine-to-machine communication within the IoT components. The rationale behind the adoption of this IoT-based solution stems from the inherent weaknesses of traditional physical key door locks, which are prone to damage and replication, consequently jeopardizing security measures. The proposed system aims to address these limitations by rendering traditional keys obsolete, thereby improving both security and convenience for users. The system has undergone comprehensive development, testing, and operationalization, resulting in a highly functional system. The success rate of all functions has consistently achieved a 100% level, which serves as an indication of the system’s robustness and effectiveness. In addition, the practical implementation of the system in the Centre of Excellence for Cybersecurity (CoExCys) office at Kuliyyah of ICT IIUM exhibited smooth operation and the absence of any operational challenges throughout a trial period lasting one week. The rmdings highlight the potential of the system as a feasible solution for enhancing security and regulating access in diverse environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Emotion Recognition using Contrastive Learning Representation of Paired Peripheral Physiological and EEG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Human emotions play a fundamental role in human-computer interaction, and accurately recognizing emotions is essential for enhancing user-friendly experiences in HCI applications. Emotions are complex and cannot be simply identified by a single modality, making multimodal approaches crucial. In this study, we propose a cross-modal representation learning approach for emotion recognition using peripheral physiological signals (PPS) and electroencephalogram (EEG). We focus on leveraging PPS, which is easier to obtain in real-life scenarios due to wearable technologies’ availability. Through contrastive learning with paired EEG signals, we aim to enhance the capabilities of PPS representation and achieve comparable performance to EEG-based models in downstream unsegmented emotion recognition tasks. We utilized the DEAP dataset and low or high arousal category for the downstream task. The results of the study demonstrate the successful learning of PPS representations that closely resemble EEG signals representations, leading to comparable performance on downstream tasks.

articleTitle: Cooking and Food Information Chatbot System using GPT-3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Computing, Engineering and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study explored the development and implementation of chatbots for informing healthy eating and addressing dietary concerns. The research problem addressed is the lack of nutritional understanding and unhealthy eating patterns among individuals, which can lead to various health issues. The study discusses the development of a chatbot called CookPal, which leverages the GPT-3 model by OpenAI to provide personalized recommendations and information about food preparation or selection that can lead users toward healthy eating habits. The study highlights the potential of chatbots in providing information about cooking and food choices. Qualitative research was adopted as an iterative approach that led to an enhanced comprehension within the scientific community by making noteworthy observations. User acceptance testing was conducted to evaluate the Chatbot’s performance, with participants providing feedback on satisfaction, relevance of responses, and usability. The results showed a high level of accuracy from the Chatbot based on User Acceptance Test, with as much as $86\%$ of the average total accuracy of all testing scenario sessions and positive user feedback with a value of 4.5 out of 5 in a scalar size of 1 to 5. Overall, this research provided valuable insight into the potential of chatbot technology in promoting healthy eating and addressing dietary concerns. The study’s findings emphasize the growing importance of integrating computer science advancements, such as $AI$ and sophisticated language models, into health and nutrition to benefit individuals in making informed and healthier lifestyle choices.

abstract: This research aims to explain the influence of information quality, customer satisfaction and customer experience on the customer experience of legal wood. Quantitative descriptive methods were applied in this research. The sample in this research was 156 consumers who had transacted legal wood on the tokoperhutani.com web commerce and was determined using an accidental sampling approach. Research results have proven that information and e-service quality positively and significantly affect customer experience. Apart from that, electronic service quality and information quality also positively and significantly impact customer satisfaction. Lastly, customer satisfaction positively and significantly affects consumer experience in transactions on the tokoperhutani.com web commerce. The results of this research provide helpful input for the management of tokoperhutani.com to find out the factors that encourage satisfaction and transaction experience so that it becomes a guide for improving service and clarity of product information on the tokoperhutani.com web commerce.
